1.title: Prologue
1.dialog: Rumors of the Tsuruga Grand Shrine traveled far and wide across the land.

2.dialog: Word goes that a God laid down the foundations for the trial grounds there and whoever had the skills (or luck) to pass the trials will be rewarded with precious artifacts crafted by the Gods themselves.

3.dialog: Every minute of careful planning leads up to this moment! Tsuruga Grand Shrine be prepared for the greatness that is me!

4.dialog: A Shrine Maiden paused sweeping and glared at me.

5.name: Shrine Maiden
5.dialog: Ugh outsiders who have no respect for the trials nor for the Shrine undermining the danger with eyes only on the ultimate prize. Do you mind moving a bit? I'm trying to sweep here.

6.dialog: Oops moving now. Though I have to assure you I am confident that my team and I will pass the fabled trials!

7.name: Shrine Maiden
7.dialog: I've heard this spoken countless times. Few actually followed through. Anyways I should be getting back to my duties so good luck out there.

8.dialog: Aww that's so nice of you Miss. If you are also in the mood to impart wisdom on how to clear the trials I'd be all ears.

9.name: Shrine Maiden
9.dialog: The only advice I will be giving you today is to go home. You'd at least leave with all your limbs intact.

10.dialog: Nope that's not an option. So since helpful words are out of the picture maybe some helpful charms and talismans...?

11.name: Shrine Maiden
11.dialog: Even if there was one it's bold of you to assume that I'd be handing them out freely. Since you have already made up your mind then there's nothing I can say or do to help. As I said before good luck.

12.name: Shrine Maiden
12.dialog: ...If Chizuko was here she would have tried her best to convince you to leave. But she doesn't understand that bullheaded folks like you just won't change your minds like that...

13.dialog: Thank you! By the way who's this Chizuko person you're talking about...?

14.name: Shrine Maiden
14.dialog: Don't even think about it. Chizuko is kind adorable and way out of your league.

15.dialog: She sounds nice and friendly! I will definitely try to befriend her after I pass the trials.

16.name: Shrine Maiden
16.dialog: Ugh you're hopeless. Now scram and stop getting in the way.

17.dialog: See you later! ...Treasure treasure here I come~

18.title: New Friends?
18.dialog: I'm tired. Exhausted. This patch of ground is nice and comfortable and I don't want to move.

19.name: Uriel
19.dialog: Well done Senpai! We have gathered a bunch of Origami Cranes. This should be enough for a reward from the Pond of Prayers.

20.dialog: Ooh a reward! I suddenly feel much more motivated to get up now. Goodbye comfortable patch of earth.

21.dialog: A very familiar Shrine Maiden swept her broom over my feet. Rude.

22.name: Shrine Maiden
22.dialog: Ugh you again...is this the "team" you mentioned last time?

23.name: Uriel
23.dialog: Good day Miss. My name is Uriel.

24.dialog: I'm so glad to see you again! As you may have guessed I passed the trials! With all my limbs intact no less!

25.dialog: Look I even got the Origami Cranes to prove it!

26.name: Shrine Maiden
26.dialog: Hmph those are authentic "Symbols of Approval". I'm surprised that you actually passed the trials. Or did this lady do all the work for you?

27.name: Uriel
27.dialog: Oh no I can't take all the credit. Senpai pulled his weight in the trial.

29.name: Shrine Maiden
29.dialog:
Good.
Why are you standing in the way? The Pond of Prayers is that way.

31.dialog: I'm * by the way. Do you mind telling me your name? I can't always call you "Miss" and we're probably going to see each other again.

36.name: KongMing
36.dialog: Instead of clearing the trials and collecting treasure for the Academy like the others I have a different mission for you. Multiple missions to be exact.

37.name: Ithil
37.dialog: * aside from passing the trials you will be infiltrating the Shrine befriending the Shrine Maidens and Priestesses.

38.name: Ithil
38.dialog: When you have done so you will try your best to uncover the secrets of the Shrine especially the source of the treasures.

39.name: KongMing
39.dialog: The treasures are effective when fighting against Chaos and any information about them would benefit us greatly.

40.name: KongMing
40.dialog: Uriel you are in charge of Senpai's safety. Shady characters have been reported to visit the Shrine and asking around may draw unwanted attention to Senpai.

41.name: Uriel
41.dialog: I swear on my Shield and my honor as a Knight that I will not allow any harm to befall Senpai.

42.dialog: Knowledge maybe? I'd like to learn more about your Shrine.

43.dialog: The God that this Shrine is dedicated to the origins of the trials the history of the treasures that sort of thing. Since you work here you must know a lot about this Shrine right? Please?

45.name: Mami
45.dialog: Most just take the treasure and leave. Not many people want to learn about our Shrine.

46.dialog: Yes that's me always eager to learn! So please? Pretty please? With cherries and ice cream and marshmallows on top?

47.name: Mami
47.dialog: I'm starting to think you are looking for diabetes instead of knowledge.

48.dialog: Aww you shouldn't insult my eating habits before you try it yourself. I know this really good cake place...

50.name: Mami
50.dialog: I'm not an expert in story-telling so you're barking up the wrong tree if it truly is knowledge that you're seeking.

51.name: Mami
51.dialog: Visit the Shrine Office at nightfall: Ms. Mizue will be recounting the history of the Shrine as well as past legends to the younger Shrine Maidens. They wouldn't mind anyone joining them.

52.name: Mami
52.dialog: However don't even think about disturbing them or I will hunt you down personally and murder you with this broom. Are we clear?

53.dialog: Aww you wound me with your suspicions.

54.name: Mami
54.dialog: It's always beneficial to be cautious. Who knows what shady businesses you outsiders are up to?

55.name: Mami
55.dialog: Now if you will excuse me I need to get back to sweeping.

58.dialog: You mentioned a girl named Chizuko last time right?

60.dialog: Do you think I can meet her? I mean a friend of yours is a friend of mine! Right?

62.title: Story Night
62.name: Uriel
62.dialog: Senpai what happened? You were so hyper before and now you're just…wallowing in misery.

63.dialog: Nothing big just a bit miffed that Mami doesn't seem to trust me. Especially after everything we've been through together!

64.name: Uriel
64.dialog: ...You've had a grand total of two conversations with her Senpai. I think you should give her more time.

65.dialog: You're right she must be taken aback by my overflowing friendliness. She probably needs more time to get used to me. Hey is that the Shrine Office up ahead?

66.dialog: Not too far away young Shrine Maidens can be seen sitting on stools and listening attentively to an elderly Priestess.

67.name: Uriel
67.dialog: Looks like we're just in time. Unfortunately all seats are taken so we must stand for the entirety of the session.

71.name: Uriel
71.dialog: She seems like a shy kid.

72.dialog: Well yet another mystery to the mix. Let's just listen to what Ms. Mizue has to say first so we can bring some information back to KongMing and Ithil.

73.name: Mizue
73.dialog: Now can anyone tell me what did we cover last time?

74.dialog: (Raises hand) You said that the land upon which our Shrine is built used to be wide fertile plains and that crops grew without being cultivated!

77.dialog: (Ah this must be the Chizuko girl Mami mentioned. She is as adorable as I imagined.)

78.name: Mizue
78.dialog: Before the Tsuruga Grand Shrine was established this region was called Sawagi meaning "moist and plentiful lands".

79.name: Mizue
79.dialog: Sawagi as Chizuko mentioned was a wide and fertile terrain. Trees bore fruit overnight and its habitants never worried about starving.

80.name: Mizue
80.dialog: Everything changed when two monsters arrived.

81.name: Mizue
81.dialog: They were brothers: the older brother was named Ao Oni while the younger brother called itself Aka Oni. Ao Oni drew in rain clouds and flooded rivers and lakes when it cried; Aka Oni brought about droughts when it laughed.

82.name: Mizue
82.dialog: They came from the Tsuyuoka region where they caused mischief.

83.name: Mizue
83.dialog: The people of Tsuyuoka had the ability to communicate with Gods. When the brothers were too much to bear with they plead to the Gods to stop the brothers.

84.name: Mizue
84.dialog: The Gods heard the prayers. They descended to the mortal world and beheaded the brothers. However they were no ordinary monsters and could survive even with their heads separated from their bodies.

85.name: Mizue
85.dialog: The brothers fled Tsuyuoka with their heads when the Gods were taken unawares.

86.name: Mizue
86.dialog: Ao Oni and Aka Oni traveled across the world suffering from hunger and the cold in search of another place to settle down. When they reached Sawagi they were bitter about what they have experienced and were jealous of the Sawagi people who lived happy and carefree lives.

87.name: Mizue
87.dialog: They robbed the people moving into the most luxurious house in the region and will only be appeased with annual offerings of treasure food and a young girl. Unlike the people of Tsuyuoka the people of Sawagi couldn't communicate with the Gods and any efforts to rebel against their oppression were met with a swift and bloody end. They had no choice but to comply with the brothers' requests.

88.name: Mizue
88.dialog: The two monsters thrived with the yearly offerings. The sacrifice was killed in cold blood and huge bonfires were raised to burn the body.

89.name: Mizue
89.dialog: Much to Aka Oni's displeasure the people of Sawagi didn't fall into poverty as it expected thanks to the fertile soil of the region.

90.name: Mizue
90.dialog: It wanted them to suffer as itself and its brother did on the travels so it started to laugh every day bringing droughts to the land.

91.name: Mizue
91.dialog: The soil gradually became barren as Aka Oni's laughs boomed across the land on a daily basis and crops stopped growing despite the best efforts of the Sawagi people.

92.name: Mizue
92.dialog: The yearly demands of food became impossible to fulfill but Aka Oni showed no mercy. It tortured the people when it didn't get what it wanted.

93.name: Mizue
93.dialog: Aka Oni finally achieved its dreams of seeing the inhabitants of Sawagi suffer as it did.

94.name: Mizue
94.dialog: When all seemed bleak Enbi no Mikoto a brave young woman and our savior decided to stand against Aka Oni and end its "rule".

95.name: Mizue
95.dialog: She wanted Sawagi to return to what it was before the brothers arrived and reasoned that the only way to achieve this was to slay Aka Oni who brought about all the droughts.

96.name: Mizue
96.dialog: ...And that's all for today. You will learn more about Enbi no Mikoto and what she did tomorrow.

97.name: Uriel
97.dialog: I wonder whether Enbi no Mikoto succeeded in killing the monster. Since she is called "the Savior" then she probably did.

98.dialog: It's likely. Or maybe she failed but her sacrifice urged the Sawagi people to rebel against the brothers like a symbol.

99.name: Uriel
99.dialog: I hope not. It's not a befitting ending for someone like her.

100.name: Uriel
100.dialog: The sun should shine bright in the sky not dragged down to the depths of the underworld.

101.dialog: Who knows? It's all speculation at this point.

102.dialog: We should come back tomorrow; I'd like to learn something about the Pond of Prayers and you can find out what happened to Enbi no Mikoto.

105.dialog: Wait I think I know who she is...you're Chizuko right?

106.name: Chizuko
106.dialog: Oh yes! But why do you know my name?

107.dialog: I'm * and this is Uriel. We were there yesterday at Ms. Mizue's lecture.

108.dialog: And I've chatted with Mami who says that you're kind and adorable.

110.name: Chizuko
110.dialog: I don't know I should be mortified that she talks about me to total strangers or be delighted that she does.

111.dialog: I'd go with delighted. I mean she surely thinks highly of you.

112.dialog: I can't say the same for myself though seeing how she always looks irritated when I'm around.

113.name: Chizuko
113.dialog: Yes that sounds like Mami. She's very protective of us you see. There was an incident where an outsider tried to kidnap a Shrine Maiden for the secrets of our Shrine.

114.name: Chizuko
114.dialog: Thankfully Mami chased him out before he succeeded or we would be in great trouble. She's been wary of outsiders ever since.

115.name: Chizuko
115.dialog: At least she hasn't chased you out with her broom yet. I think that means you're okay in her books.

116.dialog: (But she treats me like dirt...literally. With her sweeping broom.)

117.name: Chizuko
117.dialog: I'm still a Shrine-Maiden-in-training for now but I want to be like Mami in the future.

118.name: Chizuko
118.dialog: She is warm caring skillful and just the best big sister anyone can ask for!

119.name: Uriel
119.dialog: Speaking of this I'm wondering why the Shrine allowed the rumors to spread.

120.name: Uriel
120.dialog: Wouldn't it be a lot safer for you without having to deal with the Outsiders coming and going every day for the treasure?

121.name: Chizuko
121.dialog: I don't think we can stop the rumors even if we wanted to; everyone must have heard of them by now!

122.name: Chizuko
122.dialog: Besides our Senior Priestess said that it is vital to have outsiders participating in the trials instead of just us Shrine Maidens.

123.name: Chizuko
123.dialog: Seeing how the trials are...you know what you should join us again tonight. I'm sure Ms. Mizue will cover this in her narration.

125.name: Chizuko
125.dialog: Nope! You don't see people who are actually interested in the Shrine every day. Most are just here for the trial and the treasure.

126.name: Chizuko
126.dialog: Us Shrine Maidens are responsible for passing down knowledge and traditions so that's what I'm doing!

127.name: Uriel
127.dialog: Of course. We still haven't found out whether Enbi no Mikoto managed to defeat the Aka Oni or not.

129.name: Chizuko
129.dialog: Enbi no Mikoto is one of the people that I admire a lot and I like her legend a lot. I can't ruin the experience of hearing her tale for you.

130.name: Chizuko
130.dialog: Oops duty calls. See you later~

131.dialog: Judging from her tone I think Enbi no Mikoto succeeded or else she wouldn't be so enthusiastic.

133.dialog: It's time for us to head back to the trials anyway; we need to gather more Origami Cranes to exchange treasure with.

134.dialog: Or should I say "Symbols of Approval"? That's what Mami called them right?

136.dialog: Too much time has passed since I've left. What do they call this place now...Sawagi? No no it's Tsuruga the name of the Shrine.

137.dialog: Too many demons lurk in the shadows too much pain and despair threaten to consume me wherever I went so I fled...

138.dialog: But now everything has changed and the Tsuruga Grand Shrine is only a shadow of its former glory.

139.dialog: If we haven't hesitated that night and sought refuge in the Shrine…we would have changed our fates wouldn't we?

140.name: Izanami
140.dialog: I wouldn't have been infected by Chaos and you would never have left me behind…

142.name: Izanami
142.dialog: Have you ever returned to this land that we once called home?

144.dialog: I think I saw someone familiar...but she was gone when I blinked.

145.name: Uriel
145.dialog: Perhaps another student from the Academy? We're not the only ones KongMing and Ithil sent.

146.dialog: I'm not sure...maybe I'm just imagining things. Anyways we have a trial to clear. Let's do that.

147.title: Story Night…Again
147.name: Uriel
147.dialog: Senpai Senpai over here! Ms. Mizue is just about to start!

148.dialog: Coming! You are really invested in this story now Uriel.

149.name: Uriel
149.dialog: I'm afraid I won't be able to sleep soundly without knowing the end of this tale.

150.name: Uriel
150.dialog: I wonder if Chizuko made it... I can't find her with everyone wearing the same Shrine Maiden uniforms.

151.name: Mizue
151.dialog: ... Enbi no Mikoto who decided to rebel against Aka Oni donned a red dress and hid a sharpened machete among its folds.

152.name: Mizue
152.dialog: She pretended to yield to the two brothers and was taken into their residence as a servant.

153.name: Mizue
153.dialog: Aka Oni and Ao Oni were satisfied with her service and gradually trusted her with more household chores granting her access to their private space whenever she saw fit.

154.name: Mizue
154.dialog: During this time she read about the origins of the two brothers in their library.

155.name: Mizue
155.dialog: She also found a painting stuck to a scarecrow that the brothers often beat up in anger. While she didn't understand its significance she memorized every detail of the painting.

156.name: Mizue
156.dialog: One night when Aka Oni was fast asleep Enbi no Mikoto grasped her trusty machete and entered its quarters.

157.name: Mizue
157.dialog: In one firm slash Aka Oni's head was separated from its body.

158.name: Mizue
158.dialog: Enbi no Mikoto turned to leave immediately but stopped in her tracks as she remembered the scars on the necks of the brothers as well as the fact that despite being beheaded by the Gods before they still lived.

159.name: Mizue
159.dialog: Before leaving the room she set the scarecrow's head on the decapitated body of Aka Oni covered it with a thick quilt and hid Aka Oni's head in the folds of her dress.

160.name: Mizue
160.dialog: Ao Oni who was out earlier that night saw her exit Aka Oni's room. It asked: "Was your dress always this red?"

161.name: Mizue
161.dialog: Enbi no Mikoto feigned calmness: "Yes I've always worn a red dress."

162.name: Mizue
162.dialog: Ao Oni didn't notice any evidence of foul play under the dim lights of the night and allowed Enbi no Mikoto to leave with its brother's head.

164.dialog: Everyone turned to Uriel who shouted in triumph.

168.dialog: Another yell this time from Chizuko drew attention to herself.

169.dialog: Huh Chizuko shouted too. At least you're not the only one now.

170.name: Chizuko
170.dialog: Enbi no Mikoto escaped unscathed after slaying the horrendous monster. This is my favorite part of the story!

171.name: Mizue
171.dialog: I know. Your excitement when we arrive at this point of the story sure hasn't dimmed a bit despite how many times you have heard it.

172.name: Mizue
172.dialog: While it is nice to express your adoration of Enbi no Mikoto verbally it is stopping me from proceeding with the tale.

173.name: Chizuko
173.dialog: Whoops. This won't happen again I promise! I'll shout quietly next time! In my mind!

174.name: Uriel
174.dialog: (Whispers) Me too. This won't happen again.

175.name: Mizue
175.dialog: ... As I was saying Enbi no Mikoto left the brothers' residence with Aka Oni's head. The people of Sawagi were overjoyed at the announcement that the menace was gone for good.

176.name: Mizue
176.dialog: Together they burned Aka Oni's head to ashes believing that the much-loathed droughts will not harm Sawagi again.

177.name: Mizue
177.dialog: As Ao Oni didn't share Aka Oni's enthusiasm in torturing the people of Sawagi they didn't suffer as much with Aka Oni out of the picture.

178.name: Mizue
178.dialog: Although life in Sawagi was still a far cry from what it was the people were content with what they managed to achieve.

179.name: Mizue
179.dialog: During this time Ao Oni believed that Aka Oni was simply asleep from exhaustion. However it grew worried when its brother never woke up.

180.name: Mizue
180.dialog: It flung the quilt off Aka Oni's bed prepared to ask why Aka Oni was resting for such a long time but the question died on its tongue as it saw its brother's beheaded body. All that remained in the place of the head was a bunch of hay.

181.name: Mizue
181.dialog: Ao Oni rushed out of the room. As the brothers were connected by blood it was able to locate Aka Oni's head with their link. Much to its dismay it was led to a pile of ashes indicating Aka Oni's fate.

182.name: Mizue
182.dialog: While they were immortal regenerating their bodies will take months even years.

183.name: Mizue
183.dialog: Ao Oni sobbed uncontrollably as it realized that it will be parted with its brother for a long long time.

184.name: Mizue
184.dialog: Ao Oni's tears drew in heavy rain clouds and Sawagi suffered from the downpour that ensued.

185.name: Mizue
185.dialog: The rivers overflowed submerging the farmlands in floodwaters and robbing them of the ability to grow crops. What's worse the floodwaters brought about pests and plague as well.

186.name: Mizue
186.dialog: The Sawagi people who had just started to settle down again started to panic and plead Ao Oni to spare them.

187.name: Mizue
187.dialog: Ao Oni promised to cease the endless rain in exchange for the murderer of its brother.

188.name: Mizue
188.dialog: They did not hesitate to sell Enbi no Mikoto out and delivered her to the hands of Ao Oni to appease it.

189.name: Mizue
189.dialog: ... And that's all for today. We'll delve further into the story and into the fate of Enbi no Mikoto tomorrow. I'd be glad to see you join us tomorrow too.

190.dialog: Thank you we'd be honored to.

191.dialog: I can't believe the nerve of these people turning their backs to Enbi no Mikoto like that. Don't you agree Uriel... Uriel?

195.dialog: Are you okay? Your eyes are swollen and puffy.

196.name: Chizuko
196.dialog: It's just... I couldn't get the story out of my head and cried myself to sleep last night.

198.dialog: I thought you knew what happened to Enbi no Mikoto Chizuko.

199.name: Chizuko
199.dialog: I do! It's just hard to not be saddened by this part of the story despite having heard it recited countless times…but I probably should pull myself together in front of guests. (Takes several deep breaths)

201.name: Chizuko
201.dialog: So will the both of you be joining us again tonight?

202.name: Uriel
202.dialog: Of course! I have faith in Enbi no Mikoto; a strong woman like her wouldn't be stopped by hardships like this one despite how daunting it seems.

203.name: Chizuko
203.dialog: Hmm... I'd hate to spoil the experience of hearing this story for the first time

204.name: Chizuko
204.dialog: but I can assure you that no this is not the end of her story.

205.name: Chizuko
205.dialog: I think we will reach the climax of the story today. I can't wait!

206.dialog: That's good to hear. Uriel can finally stop being so nervous and fidgety.

208.name: Chizuko
208.dialog: By the way where did you come from? I keep forgetting to ask...

209.dialog: We're from Yume Academy and I'm her Senpai. Well I'm the Senpai of almost everyone in the Academy.

210.name: Chizuko
210.dialog: Yume Academy? Is it far away from here?

211.name: Uriel
211.dialog: It's located south of the Wastelands of Foehn.

212.name: Chizuko
212.dialog: The Wastelands of Foehn... I think I read about it before. And you're from further away than that? Wow!

213.dialog: It would have taken us forever to arrive here if the Academy didn't provide us with some high-tech vehicles.

214.name: Chizuko
214.dialog: Oh! Have you seen cranes on your way here? I've never seen one before!

216.name: Chizuko
216.dialog: Yes! In fact the Tsuruga Grand Shrine is named after the cranes! Well the word for crane in the local tongue that is.

217.dialog: I don't understand... if the shrine is named after them then shouldn't they be fairly ordinary here?

218.name: Chizuko
218.dialog: Nope! We don't have cranes here. They are mythical creatures you see that only appear when the Gods descend to earth. According to legends they are servants of God.

219.name: Chizuko
219.dialog: We've only seen paintings depicting them but never in real life. Many of us believed that they only exist in stories and tales.

220.name: Chizuko
220.dialog: It isn't until we heard outsiders talking about them that we knew that they are real living creatures.

221.name: Uriel
221.dialog: Well that's not the case from where we came from. While they aren't too common some can be found if you're in the right place at the right time. As a matter of fact I've seen some from afar before.

222.name: Chizuko
222.dialog: Woah! Do they really have black and white feathers with a streak of red on their heads? Do they look as elegant as the ancient scrolls say?

223.dialog: I've never read your scrolls so I'm not sure about the elegant part but yes that sounds like the cranes I've seen.

224.name: Chizuko
224.dialog: Just as the scrolls and tomes said! Cranes must have lived in the region before or our predecessors wouldn't have drawn them this accurately.

225.name: Chizuko
225.dialog: I hope I can see one myself one day! Did I tell you that one of my dreams is touching the feathers of a crane? I'm named after them you see and they're my favorite!

226.dialog: Chizuko was brimming with excitement at learning more about cranes when a passerby crashed into her causing her to fall to the ground with a yelp.

227.dialog: Tch. Get out of my way brat.

228.name: Uriel
228.dialog: How rude! Come back here and apologize to Chizuko!

229.dialog: (I have a bad feeling about that person but... I should help Chizuko now. This can wait.)

230.dialog: Are you alright Chizuko? Here I'll help you up.

231.name: Chizuko
231.dialog: Thank you! I'm just taken unawares. Look not even a scratch!

232.name: Uriel
232.dialog: I memorized what he wore. I can drag him back here so he can apologize properly.

233.name: Chizuko
233.dialog: Oh no you don't have to do that! I'm glad that you care but I think it's partially my fault too; I wasn't paying attention to my surroundings.

234.name: Chizuko
234.dialog: Besides he's gone for a while and he was wearing the uniform of his team. I don't think we can catch up to him or single him out from his team.

235.dialog: I heard the commotion. What happened Chizuko?

236.name: Chizuko
236.dialog: Senior Priestess Kugatsu! Someone ran into me and my friends here want them to apologize properly that's all.

237.name: Senior Priestess
237.dialog: (Shakes head) These outsiders are getting out of line. I'll send them a warning.

239.dialog: Hello! I am * and this is Uriel.

240.name: Kugatsu
240.dialog: Good day. I am Kugatsu Senior Priestess of the Tsuruga Grand Shrine.

241.name: Chizuko
241.dialog: Senior Priestess * and Uriel weren't trying to disrupt the order or mean harm to the shrine. I can vouch for them!

242.name: Kugatsu
242.dialog: Don't worry I'm not here to harass your friends.

243.name: Kugatsu
243.dialog: Although if memory serves me right you are supposed to be helping with preparing the ceremony.

244.name: Chizuko
244.dialog: Whoops it's time to get back to work already? I'll start right away Senior Priestess.

245.title: (Yet Another) Story Night
245.name: Mizue
245.dialog: ... Enbi no Mikoto was betrayed by the Sawagi people who handed her over to Ao Oni to appease its anger.

246.name: Mizue
246.dialog: As Aka Oni's head was burnt to ashes Ao Oni wanted Enbi no Mikoto to suffer the same fate. It built a large pyre to ensure Enbi no Mikoto will not survive.

247.name: Mizue
247.dialog: Their foul deed did not change Enbi no Mikoto's devotion of protecting the people so she walked willingly to the blazing fires.

248.name: Mizue
248.dialog: As she gazed at the flames she was reminded of the painting that the brothers seemed to be averse to.

249.dialog: All the other Shrine Maidens including Chizuko joined Ms. Mizue in reciting the story.

250.name: Shrine Maidens
250.dialog: Enbi no Mikoto had a revelation regarding the scene on the painting: it was an ancient and primal memory of the ancestors of Sawagi.

251.name: Shrine Maidens
251.dialog: The painting depicted figures of dancers amid the tendrils of fire. Following their stances Enbi no Mikoto started to dance as well.

252.name: Shrine Maidens
252.dialog: It was close to impossible to tell that this was her first time going through this routine; the moves were smooth and graceful as she twisted and twirled unscathed in the flames meant to harm her.

253.name: Shrine Maidens
253.dialog: All of a sudden the sounds of birds flapping their wings could be heard and a flock of black white and red birds appeared on the horizon.

254.name: Shrine Maidens
254.dialog: They were cranes and the flapping of their wings dispersed the rainclouds that Ao Oni summoned.

255.name: Shrine Maidens
255.dialog: Homura-Ōmikami the God watching over us all sat among the cranes and rescued Enbi no Mikoto from the fire.

256.name: Shrine Maidens
256.dialog: The people of Sawagi raised their heads in wonder watching the first God to ever descend to the Sawagi lands cradling Enbi no Mikoto in Their arms.

257.name: Shrine Maidens
257.dialog: The dance of Enbi no Mikoto gradually became the practice we call Kagura dance today.

258.name: Mizue
258.dialog: Well it's good to know that you haven't forgotten your heritage.

259.dialog: (Whispers) Just how many times have they heard this story to have it memorized down to every word??

260.name: Mizue
260.dialog: Ao Oni was beyond frightened when Enbi no Mikoto began to dance and rushed towards the ignited pyre.

261.name: Mizue
261.dialog: Much to its astonishment the flames intending to take Enbi no Mikoto's life stopped its steps and it couldn't get close to the dancing girl.

262.name: Mizue
262.dialog: Ao Oni forced itself to shed tears summoning more rainclouds but the rain failed to put out the fires.

263.name: Mizue
263.dialog: It had no choice but to wait for Enbi no Mikoto to finish her dance sealing its fate by summoning Homura-Ōmikami.

264.name: Mizue
264.dialog: The battle between Homura-Ōmikami and Ao Oni lasted for seven days and seven nights. While Ao Oni had no power against Homura-Ōmikami it had regeneration powers and fled whenever it could.

265.name: Mizue
265.dialog: In the end Homura-Ōmikami called upon the powers of the sun and Ao Oni was reduced to ashes.

266.name: Mizue
266.dialog: Unfortunately Ao Oni's death didn't restore the ruined lands of Sawagi where no crops could ever grow again.

267.name: Mizue
267.dialog: The Sawagi people prayed to Homura-Ōmikami to make the earth fertile again for the crops to grow. Enbi no Mikoto prayed as well.

268.name: Mizue
268.dialog: Moved by Enbi no Mikoto's pleas Homura-Ōmikami ordered the cranes to fly across Sawagi bringing life back to the land.

269.name: Mizue
269.dialog: However the deeds of the Sawagi people couldn't go unpunished.

270.name: Mizue
270.dialog: The farmlands of Sawagi never returned to their former fertility and the people had to work diligently to feed themselves.

271.name: Mizue
271.dialog: Before Homura-Ōmikami returned to the heavens They ordered Enbi no Mikoto to build a shrine for Them.

272.name: Mizue
272.dialog: Enbi no Mikoto named the shrine Tsuruga after the cranes that were servants of the Deity.

273.name: Mizue
273.dialog: ... And this is how the Tsuruga Grand Shrine came into being.

274.name: Uriel
274.dialog: Whew! I'm glad that everything turned out okay for Enbi no Mikoto.

275.dialog: To be honest I was expecting to learn more about the trials.

277.dialog: Ms. Mizue walked towards us as if she had overheard our conversation.

278.name: Mizue
278.dialog: Homura-Ōmikami may have defeated Ao Oni but the brothers were immortal and the danger still existed.

279.name: Mizue
279.dialog: Come back again tomorrow; the story is far from over yet.

282.name: Izanami
282.dialog: We used to walk under the moonlight holding hands all the while... but you're not here now Izanagi.

283.name: Izanami
283.dialog: There was no trace of you ever having returned; why did you stay away? Have you forgotten all about me? About us?

284.name: Izanami
284.dialog: I will find you Izanagi... No matter where you have gone.

287.name: Athena
287.dialog: I have a message from Kratos. She heard that Yume Academy sent students here to the Tsuruga Grand Shrine. Since you're already here...

288.name: Izanami
288.dialog: I am only here to seek Izanagi. This was our homeland; I will not taint the fond memories I have of this place.

290.name: Izanami
290.dialog: Enough. Just tell her what I said. I am not obliged to follow her orders.

291.name: Izanami
291.dialog: For your safety I would suggest not taking any rash actions when you're in the Shrine. It is not unguarded.

292.name: Athena
292.dialog: ... As you wish. I have another report to make: I discovered traces of Chaos activity here. I suspect it has already infiltrated the shrine.

294.name: Izanami
294.dialog: I understand. If the Chaos have the misfortune of running into me... I will end them.

295.name: Izanami
295.dialog: ... I hear footsteps. We will be getting company soon. If there are no more reports I will be taking my leave.

296.name: Athena
296.dialog: That was the last. I wish you well Izanami.

298.name: Uriel
298.dialog: What will happen next? I hope Enbi no Mikoto lived happily ever after in the end.

299.name: Uriel
299.dialog: ... Senpai? Senpai? Have you been listening to anything I said in the last minute?

300.dialog: I'm sorry Uriel but I swear I saw the same person several days ago. I can't seem to remember her identity though.

302.name: Chizuko
302.dialog: What brings you here today? And where's Uriel?

303.dialog: Ah she's still asleep. Apparently she was up all night being excited for Enbi no Mikoto and only fell asleep at sunrise so it's just me today. What are you doing?

304.name: Chizuko
304.dialog: We're preparing for the Ceremony! It will be held at night three days later. Will you be there?

305.dialog: I wouldn't miss it for anything! I'll tell Uriel about this too. What happens at this Ceremony?

306.name: Chizuko
306.dialog: It's a huge event! It's more like a Festival now that I think about it: Food Stalls Game Stalls... And we would also be having a Kagura Dance Performance!

307.name: Chizuko
307.dialog: Us Shrine Maidens tried to follow the historical texts as best as possible but it's probably not the same routine that Enbi no Mikoto went through. I can guarantee you that it's still amazing though!

308.name: Chizuko
308.dialog: I've always wanted to perform but I can't since I'm not an official Shrine Maiden yet. That and I need a lot more practice before I'm deemed worthy!

309.dialog: I'm sure you will be able to sometime soon. I can't wait to see you on stage!

310.name: Chizuko
310.dialog: Thank you! By the way you said you know Mami right? Look there she is!

311.dialog: As I turned towards the direction Chizuko was gesturing to I saw Mami Ms. Mizue Senior Priestess Kugatsu and the young shrine maiden who saved us seats during the lecture.

312.dialog: Suddenly my eyes met with Mami's cautious ones. Her expression soured.

313.dialog: Oh no Mami wouldn't be happy with me for befriending Chizuko...

314.name: Mami
314.dialog: Chizuko what are you doing with this imbecile?

315.dialog: Ouch you didn't have to be so harsh!

316.name: Chizuko
316.dialog: Hm? Aren't you friends with * Mami?

317.name: Mami
317.dialog: Ugh no. What nonsense have you been filling Chizuko's head with?

318.name: Mizue
318.dialog: Mamiko you should be kinder to your friends.

319.dialog: Ms. Mizue her name is Mami not Mamiko.

320.name: Mizue
320.dialog: Keiko? What did you just say? What about Mamiko?

321.name: Keiko
321.dialog: I said her name is Mami not Mamiko!

322.name: Mizue
322.dialog: Oh yes Mami Mami that's her name. Old age has chipped away at my hearing I'm afraid.

323.dialog: Mamiko? Sounds like a cute name and makes you and Chizuko seem more like sisters-Ouch!

325.name: Mami
325.dialog: Good job Keiko! And Ms. Mizue...I am by no means friends with this outsider.

326.name: Kugatsu
326.dialog: And you probably shouldn't be. We shouldn't be too trusting of outsiders Ms. Mizue.

327.name: Mizue
327.dialog: Haha you worry too much Kugatsu. Old age has done a number on my hearing but not on my sight nor my judge of character: I can see that this youngster here is good at heart.

329.dialog: Aww I'm so touched Ms. Mizue! By the way why does Senior Priestess Kugatsu treat Ms. Mizue so respectfully? I thought she was the leader of this Shrine?

330.name: Mami
330.dialog: Ms. Mizue is the Head Priestess of Tsuruga Grand Shrine. While Senior Priestess Kugatsu manages most worldly matters now all of us respect Ms. Mizue very much.

331.dialog: I can see that since your attitude towards me softened remarkably when Ms. Mizue came up. I have another question: why does Keiko opposes calling you Mamiko so vehemently?

332.name: Keiko
332.dialog: Everyone's name ends with "-ko" in the Shrine. Mami is one of the precious few whose name doesn't follow this pattern and I don't want her to change her name!

333.dialog: Lemme think I know five people from this Shrine and the only two whose names end in "-ko" are Chizuko and Keiko. That's not a lot.

334.name: Chizuko
334.dialog: Well we also have Tamako Chiko Kyouko Sakurako...Keiko and I are not the only ones with names like that.

335.name: Keiko
335.dialog: We were orphans when the Shrine took us in. Ms. Mizue named all of us which is why all our names end with "-ko".

336.name: Keiko
336.dialog: Mami is different: it's the name her parents gave her. It shouldn't be changed to be like us.

337.name: Mami
337.dialog: Most Shrine Maidens in the Shrine were abandoned by their parents. As for myself...I arrived after my parents passed away.

338.name: Mami
338.dialog: Keiko still has faith in parents and seems to believe that as long as the name doesn't end in "-ko" the child isn't abandoned.

339.dialog: I'm sorry to hear that. So Chizuko was...

340.name: Mami
340.dialog: ...Yes but different. Usually families who couldn't afford to raise a child will send their daughters here. We've never met Chizuko's parents: she was found in front of the Shrine's gates.

341.name: Mami
341.dialog: It was snowing that day. If I wasn't sent to run errands out of the Shrine I wouldn't have found her in time...but she was still left in the snow for far too long. I believe the over-exposure to the cold has affected her health.

343.dialog: So all of them were orphans...I see why Mami cares so much about Chizuko now: she was the one who found her in the snow.

344.dialog: All thanks to Enbi no Mikoto they have a place to call home now. I should check back on Uriel to see whether she's up. It's probably time for us to visit Ms. Mizue for more stories.

348.name: Izanami
348.dialog: Observer of Yume. I wasn't planning on meeting you so soon but since you have so generously given yourself up…

349.dialog: (Uriel isn't here... I'm not sure if I can best her in battle.)

350.name: Izanami
350.dialog: You don't have to look so alarmed; I wasn't planning on actually fighting you in the Shrine.

351.dialog: So you will do so when we're not in the confines of it? I'll take note of that when we eventually leave here. It's a truce now right?

352.name: Izanami
352.dialog: You shouldn't trust the words of your enemy. I could be waiting for you to lower your guard and strike when you're least expecting me to.

353.dialog: But you're not doing that are you? Besides I can feel the waves of depression that are rolling off of you right now...

354.name: Izanami
354.dialog: This is why I detest those like you: way too perceptive for your own good... But that's not what I'm here for. Have you by chance met my Izanagi?

355.dialog: Izanami described Izanagi's appearance in meticulous detail.

356.dialog: I don't think I've ever met someone like that sorry. Is she important to you? I'd ask the others if they have seen her.

357.name: Izanami
357.dialog: She is my beloved... While I highly doubt that you can if you manage to reunite us I can leave Kratos' forces and join Yume.

358.name: Izanami
358.dialog: Now off you go: you should be heading to the Shrine Office for stories at this hour of the day.

359.dialog: How do you know that?? Have you been stalking me??

360.title: Origin of the Trials
360.name: Uriel
360.dialog: Oh my... I can't believe I overslept. This is unbecoming behavior for a knight...

361.name: Uriel
361.dialog: I missed training too... I should wake up earlier tomorrow to make up for what I missed today.

362.dialog: Hey hey don't be too hard on yourself. A character you like very much got the happy ending she deserved and you're excited because of this. It's understandable.

363.name: Uriel
363.dialog: She reminds me of Belinus of what might have happened if... but that has nothing to do with slacking off at training!

364.name: Uriel
364.dialog: It will become a habit if I am not careful.

365.name: Mizue
365.dialog: ...As I said last time Homura-Ōmikami slew Ao Oni and ordered Enbi no Mikoto to establish a Shrine in Their honor.

366.name: Mizue
366.dialog: Yet Ao Oni and Aka Oni are immortal; they draw energy from negative emotions and will eventually regenerate their destroyed bodies and bring doom to Sawagi.

367.name: Mizue
367.dialog: Homura-Ōmikami imparted the knowledge that the amount of time the two brothers need to recover depends on the extent of damage done to their corpses.

368.name: Mizue
368.dialog: To prolong their recovery Homura-Ōmikami burned Aka Oni's body to ashes as well.

369.name: Mizue
369.dialog: The ashes of the two brothers were sealed in another plane of existence created by the God and it is only accessible from a room in the Shrine.

370.name: Mizue
370.dialog: From their remains their energies manifest as brutal monsters. Defeating such monsters will also help against their revival.

371.name: Mizue
371.dialog: Entering the plane that we call the "Realm of Trials" to battle the monsters is an age-old tradition of our Shrine.

372.name: Mizue
372.dialog: Shrine Maidens of Tsuruga as well as courageous people of Sawagi braved the Realm of Trials to engage in combat with the monsters hoping to lengthen the time the Brothers needed to recover.

373.name: Mizue
373.dialog: However they were horribly outnumbered by the monsters and casualties were large. Enbi no Mikoto prayed to Homura-Ōmikami pleading the God for assistance.

374.name: Mizue
374.dialog: In response to Enbi no Mikoto's prayers Homura-Ōmikami created two artifacts:

375.name: Mizue
375.dialog: One of them is the Pond of Prayers. It takes the shape of a regular Pond but is in fact a bottomless reserve of treasures and artifacts.

376.name: Mizue
376.dialog: True to its name it will grant every wish and prayer.

377.name: Mizue
377.dialog: However it does not allow everyone to tap into its resources. This is where the second artifact the "Gaze of Gods" comes in.

378.name: Mizue
378.dialog: The "Gaze of Gods" is rumored to be a mirror that reflects nothing. One can reach into the mirror and obtain a key to the Pond of Prayers.

379.name: Mizue
379.dialog: It is said that if you see yourself reflected in the "Gaze of Gods" it means that God is watching you through the mirror.

380.name: Mizue
380.dialog: The mirror was entrusted to Enbi no Mikoto who never hesitated to share the keys to challengers of the Trials.

381.name: Mizue
381.dialog: The keys were shaped similar to the cranes who served the God hence their name "Origami Cranes" or paper-folded cranes.

382.name: Mizue
382.dialog: Back in the time we believed those were rewards granted to the brave and called them "Symbols of Approval".

383.name: Mizue
383.dialog: With treasures and artifacts from the Pond of Prayers the challengers finally stood a chance against the monsters in the Realm of Trials.

384.name: Uriel
384.dialog: Ah so that's how the Trials and the Pond of Prayers came to be...

385.dialog: Does this mean that with the "Gaze of Gods" one can gain access to endless amounts of treasures?

386.name: Mizue
386.dialog: Enbi no Mikoto showed no discrimination when distributing the "Symbols of Approval" as long as the challengers were willing to enter the Realm of Trials.

387.name: Mizue
387.dialog: However not everyone held noble intentions; some greedy challengers left as soon as the treasure came into their possession without taking on the monsters.

388.name: Mizue
388.dialog: Infuriated Enbi no Mikoto took the treasure back from the challengers that brought the treasure away from the Shrine and stopped distributing "Symbols of Approval" freely. The treasure will only be granted moments before entering the Realm of Trials and will be taken away once the challengers return from the Trials.

389.name: Uriel
389.dialog: Oh no... I don't believe the challengers will be happy with this change.

390.name: Mizue
390.dialog: One night a bunch of evil-willed challengers gathered with the sole aim to kill Enbi no Mikoto and pry the "Gaze of Gods" from her cold dead hands.

391.name: Mizue
391.dialog: The Shrine Maidens were unfortunately outnumbered and those who could fight were worn out by the constant fights in the Realm of Trials. They were no match for the challengers.

392.name: Mizue
392.dialog: Severely wounded Enbi no Mikoto could only escape to the Realm of Trials with the "Gaze of Gods".

393.name: Mizue
393.dialog: The last thing she did was to shatter the mirror and toss the shards into the Realm of Trials so the challengers couldn't get to them.

394.name: Mizue
394.dialog: As all hope of getting their hands on the sacred artifact was lost the challengers left the Shrine in defeat. Since then shards of the "Gaze of Gods" were scattered about in the Realm of Trials never to be seen again.

395.name: Mizue
395.dialog: The only method to obtain the treasures and "Symbols of Approval" was to enter the Realm of Trials and take on the Trials.

396.dialog: What an unbelievable end to this story...

397.name: Uriel
397.dialog: Why Enbi no Mikoto why... Why is it always the ones that shine as bright as the sun that suffer such fates...

398.name: Mizue
398.dialog: When the first rays of the sun fell upon Enbi no Mikoto's body she turned into a crane and flew away.

399.name: Mizue
399.dialog: We believe that she was yet again saved by Homura-Ōmikami and ascended into the heavens to live happily ever after.

400.name: Chizuko
400.dialog: Here you are I have been looking for you! I guess Uriel cried again at this part of the story am I right?

401.dialog: And you didn't? I remember you were devastated when Enbi no Mikoto was sold out by the people she sworn to protect. That's unexpected.

402.name: Chizuko
402.dialog: I don't think Enbi no Mikoto died.

403.name: Chizuko
403.dialog: I believe that God saved her and brought her to the heavens to live happily ever after just like Ms. Mizue said!

404.name: Uriel
404.dialog: Do you really believe that? That sounds awfully self-deluding...

405.name: Chizuko
405.dialog: But Homura-Ōmikami exists and They adore Enbi no Mikoto! They won't allow Enbi no Mikoto to waste away like that!

406.name: Chizuko
406.dialog: God must have wanted her to live in a better world than this one.

407.name: Chizuko
407.dialog: I mean Homura-Ōmikami could descend to the mortal world anytime if Enbi no Mikoto asked her to and no mortal could stand against the wraith of Gods right?

408.name: Chizuko
408.dialog: At least that's what I want to believe.

409.dialog: You have a point. With the level of affection the God has shown her I wouldn't be surprised if any miracles happened.

410.name: Uriel
410.dialog: I guess so but I still feel indignant for Enbi no Mikoto. She was a good person and didn't deserve what the others did to her.

411.name: Uriel
411.dialog: But I suppose I can see it coming... The greedy ones won't be happy with Enbi no Mikoto's decision.

412.name: Chizuko
412.dialog: According to "The Chronicles of Tsuruga" Enbi no Mikoto was only sixteen or seventeen at the time. It's perfectly understandable if her choices weren't very well thought-out.

413.dialog: It's a pity that the "Gaze of Gods" is now lost. Imagine the amount of treasure you'd have if it's still in your possession!

414.name: Chizuko
414.dialog: Well you're not the first one to think like that. But anyone who causes mischief in the Shrine will be punished gravely!

416.dialog: Gaze of Gods hm? It will be mine!

417.title: Broken Trust
417.dialog: The next day I passed the information we gathered so far to Ithil and KongMing.

418.dialog: ...And that's all we've learned since we arrived here.

419.name: KongMing's Projection
419.dialog: While the credibility of their story is doubtful it can be deduced that the only method of obtaining the treasure is challenging the Trials.

420.name: Ithil's Projection
420.dialog: But so far they are the only source of information that we have. They might very well be making up a story to hide the true source of the treasure.

421.name: Ithil's Projection
421.dialog: ...Which I suspect is still hidden somewhere in the Tsuruga Grand Shrine.

422.name: Uriel
422.dialog: I don't know the story seems plausible enough for me. Ithil's theory sounds a bit paranoid to be honest.

423.name: KongMing's Projection
423.dialog: No matter what the truth is it is probably not common knowledge among the Shrine Maidens.

424.name: KongMing's Projection
424.dialog: It's highly possible that only the Head Priestess and Senior Priestess are privy to that knowledge. From how Senpai described them I doubt that they will be willing to reveal the secret to us.

425.dialog: Why not? The Yume Academy is clearly the good guys... I mean girls that fight against the Chaos.

426.dialog: Surely we can convince the Shrine to supply us with some treasure can't we? There's no need to go behind their backs.

427.name: KongMing's Projection
427.dialog: (Sighs) Secrets are meant to be kept Senpai. They wouldn't be secrets otherwise. As the most well-kept secret of the Tsuruga Grand Shrine the probabilities of them sharing it with us are very low.

428.name: Ithil's Projection
428.dialog: So far the amount of treasure we have gathered from the Trials is inadequate for our cause and time is not on our side.

429.name: Ithil's Projection
429.dialog: It would be to our advantage to find the source and try to replicate it here at Yume Academy.

430.dialog: ... This doesn't sit well with me. Chizuko and Mami are kind and honest people. I'm sure they will be able to see from our perspective if we explained the situation to them.

431.dialog: It wouldn't hurt to maintain good relationships with members of the Shrine. Since the Shrine Maidens are guardians of the Shrine they might even be able to assist us in clearing the Trials.

432.name: Uriel
432.dialog: Like how Mami gave me tips on fighting before!

433.name: Ithil's Projection
433.dialog: ... You're the Senpai I suppose. If you've made up your mind on this we'll follow your lead.

435.name: Mami
435.dialog: Hmm? Isn't that * and Uriel? Why are they hiding in a corner? Are they speaking to someone?

436.name: Mami
436.dialog: The most well-kept secret..."treasure"..."be on good relationships with members of the Shrine"… What is this?

437.name: Mami
437.dialog: I am a fool to have thought that you were different from the other outsiders. You outsiders are all greedy and ungrateful brutes who are here for the treasure only!

438.dialog: What? No Mami why are you...

439.name: Mami
439.dialog: I overheard your schemes: your friendly act was only a disguise so you could steal the secret of the treasures from us!

440.name: Mami
440.dialog: As no harm has been done yet the Shrine's rules forbid me from taking any action.

441.name: Mami
441.dialog: But I will be watching you. The moment you start something shady I will be sure to make you regret every life choice of yours that led you to Tsuruga Grand Shrine. Hmph!

442.dialog: Please Mami this is not what it looks like...

443.name: Uriel
443.dialog: It's a misunderstanding Mami we can explain...

444.dialog: Oh no she just left without hearing us out. What should we do now?

445.dialog: And I was so close to befriending her...

446.name: Chizuko
446.dialog: * Uriel! What are you doing in this secluded corner? And why do you look so dejected?

447.name: Chizuko
447.dialog: Did anything bad happen? If you are in the mood to talk I'm all ears. I heard it's therapeutic to say what's bothering you out loud!

448.dialog: Mami is mad at us and I don't know what to do...

449.name: Uriel
449.dialog: There was a misunderstanding that we need to clear up. Do you know where we can find her?

450.name: Chizuko
450.dialog: Erm if Mami doesn't want to be found I can guarantee you that no one will find her. I can try to pass on a message for you though!

451.dialog: Thank you Chizuko but I think we should explain to her in person to avoid any more misunderstandings.

452.dialog: Is it possible to arrange a meeting with her? Please? If she refuses to meet us then I suppose we would have no choice but to write her a letter and hope that it reaches her.

453.name: Chizuko
453.dialog: It's...hard but not impossible I think. Mami likes me a lot and if I beg her she might relent.

454.name: Chizuko
454.dialog: It's not every day that you see Mami being on speaking terms with outsiders and I think it's doing her a lot of good. I want all of you especially her to be happy so I'll try my best!

455.dialog: You're a lifesaver Chizuko. We're relying on you.

457.name: Uriel
457.dialog: I hope Chizuko can convince Mami to meet us...

458.dialog: If she can't then our only option is to leave her a letter hoping that she'll actually read it. Anyhow we must do our best to clear up this misunderstanding. We are not the greedy outsiders that she seems to believe us to be.

460.name: Uriel
460.dialog: Be on guard Senpai; she is a member of Krato's forces.

461.name: Izanami
461.dialog: You haven't mentioned our encounter to your bodyguard have you?

462.dialog: It's okay Uriel I met her before. She wouldn't make a move on us now.

465.name: Uriel
465.dialog: Do you have any idea how dangerous this is Senpai? She could have killed you or seriously hurt you and I would be blaming myself for shirking my responsibilities for the rest of my life!

466.dialog: Relax Uriel. I'm here and unscathed am I not?

467.name: Izanami
467.dialog: Hm as entertaining as this was shouldn't you be off to the storytelling session of the Shrine Maidens at this hour? What's keeping you?

468.dialog: Yeah about that...apparently we're bad greedy people that have eyes only on the secrets of the Shrine now. In fact Mami might be telling Ms. Mizue about us right now.

469.dialog: So probably not the best time for us to show up.

470.name: Izanami
470.dialog: Secrets of the Shrine... You are talking about the "Gaze of Gods" aren't you?

471.name: Uriel
471.dialog: Wait you know about it too?

472.name: Izanami
472.dialog: Oh I saw it in its full glory. Since you're not going to hear this story from the Shrine Maidens you might as well hear it from me.

473.name: Izanami
473.dialog: After all I do know a thing or two about what happened afterwards.

474.title: Story time with Izanami
474.name: Izanami
474.dialog: I can't remember the exact period of time when it happened only that it happened long after Homura-Ōmikami swept Enbi no Mikoto away from the mortal world.

475.name: Izanami
475.dialog: At that time the Deity frequently made its presence known sending messages to Shrine Maidens or causing miracles to happen.

476.dialog: Huh that's oddly detailed. One would think that you have actually lived through all this from the way you're telling this story.

478.name: Uriel
478.dialog: Really? So is it true that Enbi no Mikoto isn't dead just far away from here?

480.name: Uriel
480.dialog: Why do I feel like you're just trying to brush me aside?

481.name: Izanami
481.dialog: One day Ao Oni and Aka Oni reappeared to the astonishment of everyone.

482.name: Izanami
482.dialog: The Shrine Maidens estimated that it would have taken more time for them to revive. Not only have they revived before the expected time but they were also more powerful than before.

483.name: Uriel
483.dialog: Ugh those two again. Why did that happen?

484.name: Izanami
484.dialog: Because of Chaos. They drew power from Chaos which sped up their regeneration.

485.dialog: You don't do cliffhangers do you?

486.name: Izanami
486.dialog: What for? You wanted to know what happened and I'm telling you. If you wanted a storyteller you'd have to look elsewhere.

487.dialog: No no please continue. You mentioned Chaos right? Just how far back in history do the Chaos go?

488.name: Izanami
488.dialog: It's a mystery. After the monsters left the Realm of Trials a mirror flew out of the Realm and landed in the hands of the then Head Priestess.

489.name: Izanami
489.dialog: Rumor went that the "Gaze of Gods" will only appear at the Brothers' resurrection.

490.name: Izanami
490.dialog: However the treasure was ineffective against the monsters themselves. Allied with the forces of Chaos the Brothers set out to take revenge on those that tried to stop their revival.

491.name: Izanami
491.dialog: At times they submerged Sawagi with water and other times they wrecked the land with droughts. The Forces of Chaos took the opportunity to harvest as many human lives as they could.

492.name: Izanami
492.dialog: The Sawagi people were not worried at first. After all they had their own God watching over their home.

493.name: Izanami
493.dialog: They gradually lost their confidence as the Deity failed to resPond no matter how much the Shrine Maidens prayed.

494.name: Izanami
494.dialog: In their panic they flocked to the Shrine for refuge. It was the only establishment with the ability to protect everyone with a team of Shrine Maidens trained specially to fight against the monsters in the Realm of Trials.

495.name: Izanami
495.dialog: Most made it to the Shrine. Some unfortunate ones didn't.

496.dialog: Izanami paused in her narration absentmindedly touching the purple crystals on her face.

497.dialog: A tear slipped from her eye as she lost herself in her memories muttering to a person that left her and broke her heart:

498.name: Izanami
498.dialog: Izanagi Izanagi... Don't look at me...

499.name: Izanami
499.dialog: I am not infected by Chaos... I am not deformed... I will find a cure as you wished...

501.name: Uriel
501.dialog: W-What's going on Senpai? She looks distressed.

502.name: Uriel
502.dialog: (Whispers) From what she's saying this Izanagi person left her because they thought she was "deformed"?

503.dialog: (Whispers) She told me that Izanagi was her lover.

504.dialog: Snap out of it Izanami! Izanagi is not here!

505.name: Izanami
505.dialog: No... You are not here... Where have you gone? I will find you again Izanagi...

506.name: Uriel
506.dialog: This isn't right... No matter who this Izanagi person is they shouldn't have left their beloved because they were infected and scarred by Chaos.

507.name: Uriel
507.dialog: ...Wait a minute what if this is another misunderstanding just like Mami and us?

508.name: Uriel
508.dialog: Perhaps that is not the whole truth...

509.name: Uriel
509.dialog: Yes Izanagi might have left you without a goodbye but what if they caught wind of a cure and had to leave at once or risk losing the lead?

510.name: Uriel
510.dialog: And they never returned because they haven't found the cure and vowed not to return until they have done so. They wanted your reunion to be a happy one.

511.name: Izanami
511.dialog: Is that so... Is this why you never returned Izanagi? Because you love me?

513.dialog: (Whispers) Are you sure? She looks hopeful.

514.name: Uriel
514.dialog: (Whispers) Not really but the possibility exists.

515.name: Uriel
515.dialog: (Whispers) Besides if Izanagi truly abandoned her then I highly doubt that they will ever meet each other again. What's the harm in letting her have some hope?

516.name: Uriel
516.dialog: Chizuko's positivity is infectious; I want to believe that there is potential for every story to lead to a happy ending. Even yours Izanami.

517.name: Izanami
517.dialog: Hmph I know that you're just trying to comfort me but you did open my eyes to the possibility.

518.name: Izanami
518.dialog: If we meet on opposite sides of the battlefield next time I can spare your lives once.

519.dialog: Gee thanks I feel so loved. I'd appreciate it a lot if we don't end up as enemies though.

520.name: Izanami
520.dialog: ... We should continue with the story. The Shrine Maidens never lost hope and prayed to Homura-Ōmikami day and night.

521.name: Izanami
521.dialog: Finally The Deity resPonded to their prayers: the sun rose at midnight with the shrill chirp of a crane one night.

522.name: Izanami
522.dialog: Bright rays of dawn chased away the night that enveloped Sawagi and the Brothers were yet again reduced to ashes when sunlight fell upon them.

523.name: Izanami
523.dialog: The people say that the sun was the manifestation of Homura-Ōmikami and the crane that flew beside the sun as it climbed above the horizon was Enbi no Mikoto.

524.name: Izanami
524.dialog: The Forces of Chaos were vanquished and the ashes of Ao Oni and Aka Oni were returned to the Shrine.

525.name: Izanami
525.dialog: The Shrine Maidens sealed both their ashes and the "Gaze of Gods" back into the Realm of Trials.

526.name: Izanami
526.dialog: After renovations to the buildings wrecked by the Brothers' breakout were finished Tsuruga Grand Shrine hosted a Grand Ceremony to express their thanks to the God yet received no response.

527.name: Izanami
527.dialog: In fact that was the last time the God was seen in Sawagi.

528.name: Izanami
528.dialog: However the Sawagi people believed that Homura-Ōmikami never left them since the Pond of Prayers still functioned as before.

529.dialog: And you lived through all of this? Wow...

530.name: Izanami
530.dialog: Some are my own experiences and others I gathered from the locals when I returned later.

531.name: Izanami
531.dialog: I do not trust that God: They are not as good and noble as the Sawagi people believe Them to be.

532.name: Izanami
532.dialog: All They want was the faith of Their disciples: if They did care They could have destroyed the Chaos anytime! And I would never be deformed by these vile scars!

533.name: Uriel
533.dialog: I-I think I have heard about this. Before I came to Yume Academy that is.

534.name: Uriel
534.dialog: When I still belonged to the Order of the Sun a senior knight once told me that her team was assigned to defend a region against Chaos and to take down a God that has taken residence there.

535.name: Uriel
535.dialog: However the Chaos were destroyed when they arrived. The locals said it was a miracle.

536.name: Uriel
536.dialog: They investigated and found that the God died protecting the land from Chaos.

537.name: Uriel
537.dialog: Now that I think about it... She said that the land was named "Sawagi".

538.name: Uriel
538.dialog: I don't know why They didn't take any action against the Chaos in the beginning. Perhaps it wrongly believed that the Chaos was no match for it... and paid dearly for this misjudgment.

539.name: Izanami
539.dialog: Homura-Ōmikami died... protecting us? I I don't...

541.dialog: (Cackles) Ah Ahhh so the Brothers' resurrection is tied to the "Gaze of Gods"... I know just the thing to do now!

544.name: Uriel
544.dialog: No time for sleeping Senpai! Those are emergency alarms. Get up!

547.dialog: Can anyone fill me in on the situation? Why is everyone running?

548.name: Kugatsu
548.dialog: (Shouting) There has been a breach of security in the Realm of Trials! Please stay away from the entrance and leave the premises as soon as possible!

549.name: Kugatsu
549.dialog: I repeat please steer clear of the entrance and leave the premises!

550.name: Uriel
550.dialog: A breach of security...? Sounds ominous especially when Ao Oni and Aka Oni is involved.

551.name: Uriel
551.dialog: Look a group of Shrine Maidens is approaching the entrance to the Realm of Trials instead of escaping from it!

552.dialog: Oh no Mami is among them too! We must help her!

553.name: Kugatsu
553.dialog: Stop right there! If you want to leave unscathed you should be running away from the Realm of Trials not towards it.

554.dialog: But... But... Mami and the others are heading towards the Realm too! Why aren't you stopping them?!

555.name: Kugatsu
555.dialog: They are trained and prepared for situations like this one. You are not.

556.dialog: We can still help! We've cleared the Trials repeatedly now.

557.name: Uriel
557.dialog: We consider Mami as a friend and we will never leave a friend in need. If there is anything that we can help with we will do it.

558.name: Kugatsu
558.dialog: ... I suppose I should trust Ms. Mizue's judgment this time. Don't make me regret this.

560.name: Kugatsu
560.dialog: Mami belongs to a special force of Shrine Maidens the Blazing Eagles.

561.name: Kugatsu
561.dialog: The Brothers sealed in the Realm of Trials are showing signs of resurrection and the Blazing Eagles are sent to buy time for everyone else to escape.

562.name: Kugatsu
562.dialog: We are no match for them. Without Homura-Ōmikami's assistance we have no chance of winning.

563.name: Kugatsu
563.dialog: To make matters worse the Beasts of Chaos have appeared by their side just like what happened in the past.

564.name: Kugatsu
564.dialog: This is the last chance for you to change your minds. You can still choose to leave and to live.

565.dialog: Well I don't know about Monsters but Chaos Beasts are right in our area of expertise.

566.name: Uriel
566.dialog: After all we're from the Yume Academy!

567.dialog: Uriel I need you to gather the other Girls who were sent here so we can take on the Chaos Beasts together.

568.dialog: I will join forces with Mami.

569.name: Uriel
569.dialog: Are you certain? The Realm of Trials is not safe now... I can always go in your place and the Girls will resPond to your orders faster than mine.

570.dialog: We don't have time for this argument Uriel. Trust me; I won't go down that easily.

571.name: Uriel
571.dialog: ... If you insist. Be safe Senpai.

572.name: Izanami
572.dialog: Listen to your Senpai young Knight. I'll make sure your Senpai returns to you safe and sound.

575.name: Mami
575.dialog: Take this you brute! This broom is gifted to me by Homura-Ōmikami and works best against vile creatures like you!

577.name: Mami
577.dialog: Ugh you again. Go away I don't have time to deal with you now.

578.name: Mami
578.dialog: And why is another girl accompanying you instead of Uriel? Did you ditch her?

579.name: Izanami
579.dialog: Oh no. I have no intentions of starting another relationship just yet.

580.dialog: It's not what it looks like between Izanami and me! And we're here to help!

581.name: Mami
581.dialog: Help? We're here as a suicide squad not as treasure hunters!

582.name: Mami
582.dialog: Treasure seekers like you should be running for your lives not towards danger.

583.dialog: I know you don't trust me after what you overheard but please let us help you.

584.dialog: I am the Observer of Yume Academy and am experienced in dealing with Chaos Creatures.

585.dialog: Besides we never did clear up that misunderstanding yet and we can't do that if you're six feet under can we?

586.name: Mami
586.dialog: You... Fine if we end up pulling through I will listen to what you have to say. No promises on forgiveness though.

588.name: Izanami
588.dialog: If you are done with flirting I can use some help dealing with these Chaos Beasts here.

589.name: Izanami
589.dialog: You'd think people would be more considerate when you're separated from your lover but no they have to rub salt in the wound... (Mutters)

590.name: Mami
590.dialog: I'm not... We're not... Ugh. Let's get this over with.

592.name: Uriel
592.dialog: I rounded up everyone I could find. I hope we're not too late...

594.dialog: Annnnd now it's time to show these Monsters and Chaos Beasts why it's a bad idea to mess with Yume Academy!

595.title: Michinashi
595.dialog: Gwen Brigit mind giving that Shrine Maiden over there a hand? She looks overwhelmed.

596.name: Gwen & Brigit
596.dialog:
On it~
O butterfly fluttereth thy wings!

599.dialog: Angelica I need you to take care of the Chaos Beasts on the western front!

600.name: Angelica
600.dialog: Consider it done... My arrows shall bring me honor!

601.dialog: Holly what's the status of the wounded?

602.name: Holly
602.dialog: Don't worry Senpai everyone in the forest is with me~

603.name: Mami
603.dialog: Huh you weren't bluffing about being professionals.

604.dialog: I am really tempted to say something obnoxious like "I told you so" right now…

605.name: Mami
605.dialog: Yeah yeah rub it in. If you're such a hotshot then you wouldn't turn down some friendly competition to see who takes down more Monsters and Chaos Beasts will you?

606.name: Mami
606.dialog: I'll even let you have a head start since I'm well-trained to take down those Monsters.

607.dialog: You might be but what about those Chaos Beasts? I have way more experience dealing with them than you.

609.dialog: Tch where did these losers come from? I could have overwhelmed those Shrine Maidens easily...

610.dialog: Can they be from the Yume Academy that are rumored to have defeated Dire and Magma Demon?

611.dialog: Ao Oni and Aka Oni are useless; with the amount of Chaotic Energy that they have absorbed they should be revived now but no.

612.dialog: I wouldn't have given them this much of my powers if it wasn't for the "Gaze of Gods".

613.dialog: Those fools only have their eyes on the treasure from the Pond of Prayers overlooking the "Gaze of Gods" which is an impressive artifact itself.

614.dialog: Ah I know just what to do to hasten the rebirth of these two Brothers...

616.dialog: What's going on?! We had the situation under control but these Monsters and Chaos Beasts came out of nowhere!

617.name: Mami
617.dialog: (Pants heavily) Us Shrine Maidens have been working with the challengers to fight against the waves of Monsters through the years. We've never fully vanquished them.

618.name: Mami
618.dialog: However the energies from the negative emotions aren't enough for the Brothers to revive yet. The Monsters must have been stirred up by the Chaos...

619.name: Mami
619.dialog: I thought we would be able to pull through with your help since this is Chaos-related.

620.name: Mami
620.dialog: ... But it seems like I am wrong.

621.dialog: ...Something doesn't add up. I don't know much about Monsters the Brothers or energies from negative emotions but the Chaos Beasts are not acting the way they should.

622.name: Izanami
622.dialog: That is true. These Chaos Beasts are overexerting themselves with a clear aim while they usually go after any trace of energy mindlessly.

623.name: Izanami
623.dialog: There must be another intelligent Chaos being manipulating them one that overpowers the regular Chaos Beasts.

624.dialog: Powerful and intelligent Chaos Creature... This sounds awfully like another Chaos Lord.

626.dialog: A higher being among the Forces of Chaos... We've slain two already and we can certainly defeat a third one.

627.dialog: It shouldn't be too far away if it is controlling these Chaos Beast. Girls can you check for anything out of place?

628.name: Gwen & Brigit
628.dialog: All clear on the eastern and southern fronts!

630.name: Uriel
630.dialog: Senpai I spotted a suspicious entity in the north!

634.dialog: Wait a human? But you are oozing Chaotic Energy...

635.dialog: Ah you must be referring to this human body. A rather useful one I'd say especially when I need to stay under the radar.

636.dialog: As you have found me it has exhausted its usefulness. As a reward... I shall reveal to you my true name and form.

637.name: Michinashi
637.dialog: I am Michinashi a Chaos Lord. Learn to fear this name and cower when it is uttered.

639.name: Izanami
639.dialog: Strange it seems weaker than other Chaos Lords...

640.name: Izanami
640.dialog: Though what it lacks in strength is probably made up for in stealth. I wouldn't complain; it does make my life easier.

641.name: Uriel
641.dialog: Repent your sins to the rays of the sun vile creature…

642.name: Uriel
642.dialog: ... And regret every decision that led you to defile the land that Enbi no Mikoto vowed to protect!

643.title: Kagura Dance
643.name: Michinashi
643.dialog: No! I refuse to accept this!

644.name: Michinashi
644.dialog: Puny humans like you shouldn't be able to best me! If the two useless Brothers hadn't drained so much energy from me you would be dead now!

645.name: Michinashi
645.dialog: But don't think you've won: even if I will be no more the Brothers are already revived. You will all die here. Muahahahaha!

646.name: Michinashi
646.dialog: Too bad that I won't be here when the "Gaze of Gods" is assembled again... I envy the lucky one who manages to get their hands on it...

647.name: Mami
647.dialog: Hey is it just me or is the earth rumbling?

648.dialog: The ground started to shake violently.

650.dialog: Countless Monsters poured out from the entrance of the Realm of Trials.

651.dialog: Two ominous and gigantic figures stood among the expanding swamp of Monsters created from negative emotions.

652.name: Ao Oni
652.dialog: We live again Brother... And with our rebirth we shall bring doom to everyone who dares to stand in our way.

653.name: Mami
653.dialog: Is there truly no more hope for us...?

655.dialog: A ray of light protruded from the veil of negative emotions enveloping the entrance to the Realm of Trials.

656.dialog: It came from a mirror shining as bright as the rising sun and dispersed the night with its radiance.

657.dialog: As its spectators marveled at its brilliance the mirror flew into the Shrine and disappeared out of sight.

658.name: Ao Oni
658.dialog: That is... The artifact of that God! It will not fall into the hands of you hateful mortals this time!

660.name: Mami
660.dialog: It is our only hope. I have to stay and fight with the Blazing Eagles. Can I trust you to bring it back to us *?

661.dialog: Oh you're not worried that a "greedy outsider" like me will just make off with it and leave now?

662.name: Mami
662.dialog: No I'm not. You have proven yourself to be worthy of my trust.

664.dialog: The "Gaze of Gods" flew in this direction... Over there! It's still glowing!

666.dialog: Chizuko? I thought you left with the others. What are you doing here?

668.dialog: Monsters noticed them and huddled in their direction.

669.dialog: Look it's dangerous here and I'm on my way to retrieve the "Gaze of Gods". Can you get to safety by yourself?

671.dialog: There was no indication that Chizuko heard *'s words nor did she react to the Monsters gradually closing up on her. She just walked slowly forward.

672.dialog: Something's wrong but what? Michinashi is dead and there are no signs of Chizuko being possessed by Chaos.

673.dialog: I can't leave her alone like this...

674.dialog: As * fought the Monsters Chizuko kept walking towards the "Gaze of Gods".

675.dialog: The artifact slowly descended from the sky and turned into a ray of light that entered Chizuko's small frame.

677.dialog: Is Chizuko... dancing? And the birds flanking her are... Cranes?

678.name: Shrine Maidens
678.dialog: "...the moves were smooth and graceful as she twisted and twirled unscathed in the flames meant to harm her."

679.name: Shrine Maidens
679.dialog: "All of a sudden the sounds of birds flapping their wings could be heard and a flock of black white and red birds appeared on the horizon."

680.dialog: Is that the fabled Kagura Dance?!

684.name: Chizuko
684.dialog: Oh please don't push the person in front of you this wouldn't help you escape faster!

686.name: Chizuko
686.dialog: The Shrine is mostly vacated now... I think it's okay for me to leave too.

687.name: Chizuko
687.dialog: I'm worried about Mami and the others. I could have been fighting with them if I wasn't so frail and weak...

688.name: Chizuko
688.dialog: ... Wishful thinking like that wouldn't help them now. I should trust them; members of the Blazing Eagles are well-trained for situations like this.

689.name: Chizuko
689.dialog: I need to get to safety so they won't be worried about me.

692.name: Chizuko
692.dialog: Where...am I? Where am I heading to...?

693.name: Chizuko
693.dialog: I feel warm and floaty like walking on clouds...

700.name: Chizuko
700.dialog: Wh-What's going on?! And what am I wearing?

701.dialog: Welcome back Chizuko you really got us worried back there. How do you feel now?

702.name: Chizuko
702.dialog: *? What happened? Why am I here?

703.dialog: No idea. I tried to talk to you but you didn't seem to have heard me and started to dance after you walked here.

704.dialog: Oh and the "Gaze of Gods" seems to have fused with you somehow. Can you feel it?

705.name: Chizuko
705.dialog: Fused with me? So it's inside me?? But I don't feel anything!

706.dialog: A Monster charged at Chizuko screaming shrilly.

709.dialog: Chizuko thrust her arms forward to shield herself from the Monster only for a beam of sunlight to shine out from her long sleeves and searing it to ashes.

710.dialog: That was awesome Chizuko I didn't know you could do that!

712.name: Shrine Maiden
712.dialog: (Screams from far away) Kyouko! Stay with us Kyouko!!

713.name: Aka Oni
713.dialog: Muahahahaha all of you shall perish!!

714.name: Chizuko
714.dialog: It's Mami and the Blazing Eagles! They're in danger...

715.name: Chizuko
715.dialog: I was weak before but with this power...

718.name: Mami
718.dialog: Something is flying towards us. Those are... cranes!

719.name: Kyouko
719.dialog: This light... Our God is back with us...

720.name: Ao Oni
720.dialog: You are a lot shorter than I remembered you to be Homura-Ōmikami.

721.name: Ao Oni
721.dialog: It's impossible! How are you still alive?!

722.name: Chizuko
722.dialog: (Get a grip on yourself Chizuko. Do not be intimidated by these Monsters.)

723.name: Chizuko
723.dialog: (I have the power to protect everyone in the Shrine. I will not back down!)

724.name: Chizuko
724.dialog: No matter what you say vile creatures I will put a stop to your evil deeds today!

725.name: Mami
725.dialog: (Whispers) This voice... Chizuko? It's happening now...

726.dialog: Uh yes it's Chizuko. Are you alright Mami? Are you hurt or injured anywhere?

727.name: Mami
727.dialog: Hmph of course not. Who do you think I am?

728.name: Mami
728.dialog: (Whispers furiously) Don't tell anyone else about Chizuko!

729.dialog: Don't worry I'm not planning on doing that. Wait did you know that this will happen to her?

730.name: Mami
730.dialog: It's a long story. I'll explain later.

731.name: Ao Oni & Aka Oni
731.dialog: Homura-Ōmikami! We shall not fall to you once more. Face our hatred!

732.name: Chizuko
732.dialog: You may try but know that you are doomed to fail. Be prepared to repent for your sins!

733.title: New Allies
733.dialog: Last night when the light faded both the Brothers and the Monsters disappeared.

734.dialog: Chizuko was unconscious and Mami carried her all the way back.

735.name: Chizuko
735.dialog: I heard from the others that you helped us with fighting the Chaos creatures and the Monsters! I can't thank you enough for everything you have done for us *!

736.name: Chizuko
736.dialog: I can't believe I slept through all of that and even missed witnessing Homura-Ōmikami in Their full glory...

739.dialog: Mami cleared her throat and glared.

740.dialog: ...Uh yeah I'm sorry that you missed it too.
