741.name: Chizuko
741.dialog: Thankfully Mami promised that she will tell me everything in detail.

742.name: Chizuko
742.dialog: Besides if the only time Homura-Ōmikami will appear is when the Monsters are invading this world I'd settle for never seeing Them.

743.name: Kugatsu
743.dialog: I apologize for interrupting you in the middle of a conversation Chizuko but we have important matters to discuss with our honored guests from Yume Academy.

744.name: Chizuko
744.dialog: Oh you're going to talk about secrets! I'll get going then.

745.name: Kugatsu
745.dialog: I had a discussion with President KongMing yesterday who explained your situation.

747.name: Mami
747.dialog: Nope you just dropped your communicator. I found it when I was sweeping.

748.name: Mami
748.dialog: She was attempting to contact you so we talked to her. I'm sorry for the misunderstanding by the way.

749.dialog: It's okay we were acting quite suspicious in retrospect.

750.dialog: Is everything resolved yesterday? Are there any more threats or dangers lingering on the horizon?

751.name: Kugatsu
751.dialog: Everything is under control now. The Brother's ashes are sealed securely in the Realm of Trials and the "Gaze of Gods" has been restored to its rightful place as well.

752.name: Kugatsu
752.dialog: As for what happened to Chizuko... I implore you to keep Chizuko's conditions in secrecy for now.

753.dialog: By the way what actually happened to her? And why doesn't she remember anything today?

754.name: Kugatsu
754.dialog: Chizuko has the potential to be a vessel of Homura-Ōmikami's powers. She can draw upon Their strength through her prayers.

755.name: Kugatsu
755.dialog: We were worried that she would not be able to comprehend the implications of hosting such powers at a young age so we kept it a well-hidden secret and treated her as we would any other Shrine Maiden.

756.name: Kugatsu
756.dialog: Her loss of memory can probably be ascribed to her being overwhelmed by the divine strength of Homura-Ōmikami. Personally I feel like not having this memory is more a blessing than a curse for her.

757.dialog: I see... Don't worry I won't blab.

758.name: Kugatsu
758.dialog: Thank you. I would also like to inform you that Chizuko will leave with you on your day of departure and enroll in Yume Academy.

759.name: Kugatsu
759.dialog: While we will never cease worrying for her your actions yesterday have proven your trustworthiness. Combined with the fact that both Mami and Ms. Mizue vouched for you I believe that you will take good care of her.

760.name: Kugatsu
760.dialog: I brought this up in my discussion with President KongMing last night and all the arrangements have been made.

761.dialog: That's unexpected. Do you mind me asking why?

762.name: Kugatsu
762.dialog: Our training here at Tsuruga Grand Shrine only involves fighting against Monsters but not Chaos Creatures which is a field that Yume Academy specializes in.

763.name: Kugatsu
763.dialog: Currently Chizuko is next in line for the position of Head Priestess. However she will need more training before she can be qualified to succeed Ms. Mizue as leader of the Shrine.

764.name: Kugatsu
764.dialog: President KongMing has also confirmed that she meets all the requirements to enroll in Yume Academy and that there is space for her on campus.

765.dialog: Don't worry! We're all very friendly and welcoming at the Academy. I reassure you that she will be in good hands.

766.name: Kugatsu
766.dialog: In exchange Tsuruga Grand Shrine will provide some aid for Yume Academy.

767.name: Kugatsu
767.dialog: Usually we Shrine Maidens only keep a bare minimum of "Symbols of Approval" for our use and return the rest to the Realm of Trials.

768.name: Kugatsu
768.dialog: Starting from now we will entrust the "Symbols of Approval" we acquired from the Realm of Trials to Yume Academy.

769.name: Kugatsu
769.dialog: We will also share some tips on the Trials. We hope that these would be of help to your confrontation against Chaos.

770.dialog: Thank you... This means a lot to us.

771.name: Kugatsu
771.dialog: You have helped us in our hour of need; now we are merely returning the favor.

772.name: Kugatsu
772.dialog: That's all I have to say. If you have no more questions I'd be taking my leave. There are still many issues from last night waiting to be resolved.

773.dialog: Good luck with that. Well I suppose it's time for me to head back now.

774.name: Mami
774.dialog: Not so fast *. Despite the commotion last night the Ceremony tonight will be held as planned.

775.name: Mami
775.dialog: Chizuko asked me to inform you that she would like to be your guide in the Ceremony and to wait at the gates tonight.

777.dialog: I thought I'm not your Senpai until you officially enroll in Yume Academy?

778.name: Chizuko
778.dialog: True but I like calling you Senpai! It feels like we are closer this way.

780.name: Chizuko
780.dialog: It beats pulling a long face every day in my books. Let's go! There are so many stalls that you should visit!

782.name: Chizuko
782.dialog: You have to try Sakurako's Takoyaki! They're to die for!

783.name: Chizuko
783.dialog: Oooh there's the Goldfish Scooping Stall of Kotoko! The goldfish there are very healthy and can live for a long time.

784.name: Chizuko
784.dialog: It's getting pretty busy now... This way I know the best spot to watch the fireworks!

785.dialog: She sure looks like she's having fun.

786.name: Uriel
786.dialog: But she's a good guide. The takoyaki is exquisite!

788.name: Chizuko
788.dialog: Oh those are masks of Ao Oni and Aka Oni based on their descriptions in the legends.

789.name: Chizuko
789.dialog: I think they're changing the designs next year since we've seen what they look like now.

790.name: Uriel
790.dialog: To be honest I thought such designs would scare you after what they did but you're surprisingly okay with them.

791.name: Chizuko
791.dialog: A Head Priestess in the past once said that we should face our fears instead of hiding from them.

792.name: Chizuko
792.dialog: It went something along the lines of "If poor imitations could paralyze you with fear then what will you do when you face the real deal?"

794.name: Chizuko
794.dialog: This reminded me. You joined our lessons halfway through so you missed the beginning!

795.name: Uriel
795.dialog: The beginning? Is Enbi no Mikoto involved anyhow?

796.name: Chizuko
796.dialog: You've become quite the Enbi no Mikoto fan too! Sadly that would be a no. It's actually about Ao Oni and Aka Oni.

797.name: Chizuko
797.dialog: Ao Oni and Aka Oni were born in the faraway village of Tsuyuoka. They had no father and their mother was an ordinary human being.

798.name: Chizuko
798.dialog: One night the skies were painted an ominous shade and Monsters roamed the land. Their mother found herself pregnant and gave birth to the Brothers after ten days.

799.name: Chizuko
799.dialog: She was horrified when she saw her babies' deformed faces and the horns that grew from their foreheads signs of them being of demonic nature.

800.name: Chizuko
800.dialog: However she couldn't bring herself to kill them and decided to raise them secretly.

801.name: Uriel
801.dialog: ...They were children. Even if they committed unspeakable crimes in their adulthood they were innocent as kids.

802.name: Uriel
802.dialog: I probably would have made the same choice as the mother if I was in her shoes.

803.name: Chizuko
803.dialog: When their mother discovered their powers she laid down rules that regulated the use of their powers hoping for them to have a normal childhood.

804.name: Chizuko
804.dialog: Despite her efforts Tsuyuoka still suffered from frequent droughts since the birth of the Brothers because Aka Oni often snickered when its mother's back is turned.

805.name: Chizuko
805.dialog: The villagers soon discovered the culprit of the droughts. Their mother tried to flee the village with them but was captured by the enraged villagers.

806.name: Chizuko
806.dialog: The people of Tsuyuoka beat the mother to death with rocks and attempted to burn them alive in order to "cleanse their sins" a method that they learned from the legends.

807.name: Chizuko
807.dialog: Ao Oni sobbed uncontrollably upon witnessing its mother's death and its cries called upon thick rain clouds. Soon Tsuyuoka was submerged by a flood brought by the heavy rain.

808.name: Chizuko
808.dialog: The Brothers realized that the murderers of their mother were no match for them at all and took their revenge by taking over Tsuyuoka.

809.name: Chizuko
809.dialog: They demanded offerings of treasure from the people of Tsuyuoka and a young girl to be sacrificed to them on the day of their mother's death.

810.name: Chizuko
810.dialog: They will then beat the sacrifice to death with a stone and burn her alive. How horrible!

811.dialog: That's what the people of Tsuyuoka did to them isn't it?

812.name: Uriel
812.dialog: I don't think it's right to torture an innocent like that even if their revenge is justified.

813.name: Chizuko
813.dialog: That's why they're Monsters. Enbi no Mikoto was treated unjustly too but she has always resPonded with kindness instead of hatred.

814.name: Uriel
814.dialog: That's why I admire her so much.

815.name: Chizuko
815.dialog: Senior Shrine Maidens also told us to learn from Enbi no Mikoto and not from the Monsters.

816.name: Chizuko
816.dialog: And you know the rest: the people of Tsuyuoka prayed to their God who defeated the Brothers.

817.name: Chizuko
817.dialog: The Brothers arrived here when they fled Tsuyuoka.

818.name: Chizuko
818.dialog: But they were still defeated by our God!

821.dialog: Boom! Boom! Boom! Three huge fireworks bloomed in the sky.

822.name: Uriel
822.dialog: Woah they're larger than the others and so much prettier.

823.name: Chizuko
823.dialog: Oooh it's time for the Kagura Dance performance!

824.name: Chizuko
824.dialog: Let's go! If we don't secure a good spot now all we're going to be able to see will be the heads of the audience!

825.title: Finding a New Teammate
825.dialog: To encourage its students to participate in the Trials of the Tsuruga Grand Shrine Yume Academy is hosting its first "Tsuruga Cup" Contest.

826.dialog: To enter this contest students need to team up with other students in their House challenge the trials acquire rewards from them and hand in the rewards to the Academy.

827.dialog: The six Houses will be ranked based on the amount and value of rewards submitted by their students and the House ranked at the top will receive a special present courtesy of the Student Union.

828.dialog: Yume Academy stirred as students geared up to participate in this challenge that requires both luck and competence.

829.dialog: However a certain student seems to be having a hard time finding teammates…

831.name: Saint
831.dialog: What's going on Bud Elf? Why aren't you participating in the trials like the others?

832.name: Saint
832.dialog: Without you House Fairy is no match for House Human.

834.name: Susan
834.dialog: Elffie~ My dear Elffie~ Can you promise not to be angry at me? I have something important to tell you~

835.name: Bud Elf
835.dialog: What is it? Did you mess up the fertilizer mix again or forget to water the flowers yesterday?

836.name: Susan
836.dialog: I did none of that!! Put your flower down Elffie!!

837.name: Susan
837.dialog: Well my dear Elffie here's the thing: your dear Susy has an emergency and can't be your teammate for the Trials.

838.name: Susan
838.dialog: You might want to find someone else to be your teammate~ Don't worry I'm sure that everyone will kill to join your team~

839.name: Bud Elf
839.dialog: … And that's why my previous teammate Susan is not here with me.

840.name: Bud Elf
840.dialog: As per the rules of the Academy students must form teams of at least two to take on the Trials but I can't find anyone to join my team!

841.name: Saint
841.dialog: What about other students in House Fairy? They can't all be teamed up already right?

843.name: Bud Elf
843.dialog: Mio I need to ask you something…

844.name: Mio
844.dialog: Meow it's Bud Elf! Mio did not pick Bud Elf's flowers today no Mio didn't!

846.name: Bud Elf
846.dialog: Oh hi Kassy. Do you want to challenge the Trials with me?

847.name: Kassy
847.dialog: I'm sorry Bud Elf but I've already joined someone else's team.

848.name: Bud Elf
848.dialog: It's alright Kassy… What about you Elloi?

851.name: Bud Elf
851.dialog: It's obvious that no one wants to join my team!

852.name: Saint
852.dialog: That's a pity. If I wasn't in House Human I'd love to be your teammate.

853.name: Saint
853.dialog: However as the former House President of House Human it's my responsibility to lead House Human to victory.

855.name: Saint
855.dialog: I should go; my teammates are calling for me. I wish you luck on your search for teammates. House Human will win fair and square not because its rival is weakened.

856.name: Bud Elf
856.dialog: … Okay! I don't need any lousy teammates anyway I can clear a trial all on my own!

857.name: Bud Elf
857.dialog: As long as no one catches me I won't get in trouble for heading into the Realm of Trials alone!

858.name: Bud Elf
858.dialog: I will make them regret not teaming up with me!

859.dialog: Please don't… It's too dangerous for you to go alone Bud Elf…

860.name: Bud Elf
860.dialog: Who are you?? Let go of my leg!

862.name: Bud Elf
862.dialog: Can't you speak a whole sentence without stuttering? Wait a minute I think I know you. You're one of the juniors of our House aren't you?

863.name: Bud Elf
863.dialog: I don't know you that well so feel free to go tell on me to Senpai and the others but please let go of my leg.

864.name: Holly
864.dialog: My name is… Holly… Whew that was hard…

865.name: Holly
865.dialog: I am not a snitch but… but I won't let go either.

866.name: Holly
866.dialog: You're not supposed to take on a Trial alone… The rules state that the trials can only be challenged by two or more students!

867.title: Bud Elf's Biggest Fan
867.name: Holly
867.dialog: I'm not letting go… It's too dangerous for you to go alone…

868.name: Bud Elf
868.dialog: I don't have a choice! No one wants to team up with me so the only way left is to go by myself.

869.name: Holly
869.dialog: I… I can try to persuade others to join your team…

870.name: Holly
870.dialog: People are convinced that you are a soft-hearted person so they underestimate your strength…

871.name: Holly
871.dialog: When they finally open their eyes to how strong you are everyone will want to take on the trials with you…

873.name: Bud Elf
873.dialog: Are you sure you're not talking about someone else?

874.name: Holly
874.dialog: I don't think so… It's impossible to mistake someone else for you!

875.name: Holly
875.dialog: You are extremely kind and patiently water me every day.

876.name: Holly
876.dialog: You are the one who carries me out from the Greenhouse to bask in the sun

877.name: Holly
877.dialog: and the one who chases the birds away when they come pecking at me…

878.name: Bud Elf
878.dialog: Wait I don't remember doing any of this for a person. Who are you?

879.name: Holly
879.dialog: As I said I am Holly… The climber plant on the trees of the Gardening Club…

880.name: Holly
880.dialog: I return to my plant form from time to time to rest but I never hurt those trees nor have I drained nutrients from them…

881.name: Bud Elf
881.dialog: Senpai did tell me that one of the newbies was a sentient plant.

882.name: Bud Elf
882.dialog: I thought he was talking nonsense but it seems like I was wrong.

883.name: Bud Elf
883.dialog: So you are that Holly hmm? That explains why it disappears sometimes. I thought it died because I didn't take good care of it.

884.name: Holly
884.dialog: But you did! You are always patient and kind to us and all plants adore you!

885.name: Holly
885.dialog: I think that's why the other students don't believe that you can hold your own in the Trials…

887.name: Holly
887.dialog: … But they don't know about your incredible strength! No matter how heavy the flower pots are you can carry them all by yourself.

888.name: Holly
888.dialog: Once I tell them about this they will know that you can pull your weight in the Trials and you won't have to worry about not having teammates anymore!

889.name: Holly
889.dialog: … Unlike me who is no help at all because I'm just bad at PE.

891.name: Bud Elf
891.dialog: I have to admit you're a funny one. The real reason that no one wants to team up with me is not because of my "kindness".

892.name: Bud Elf
892.dialog: Haven't you heard the names the others have for me?

893.name: Bud Elf
893.dialog: One of the Seven Mysteries of the Academy the nightmare of the Gardening Club the local weirdo the "Power Girl"…

895.name: Bud Elf
895.dialog: They do not shun me because I lack strength. On the contrary they shun me because of my strength.

896.name: Bud Elf
896.dialog: No matter what they think I will not change my principles: whoever hurts plants will be punished!

897.name: Holly
897.dialog: But… But… The rules of Senpai and the Student Union…

898.name: Holly
898.dialog: And you need someone to watch your back no matter how strong you are…

899.name: Bud Elf
899.dialog: Ugh we're just going around in circles. Wait aren't you in House Fairy too?

900.name: Bud Elf
900.dialog: Then it's settled: you can come with me to challenge the trials. I have someone to watch my back and you don't have to worry about me breaking the rules.

901.name: Holly
901.dialog: M-Me? But I… I can't… Please let go of me…

902.name: Bud Elf
902.dialog: You're the one that won't let go of my leg in the first place! Now stop whining and let's go!

904.name: Holly
904.dialog: What should I do? I won't be of any help to Bud Elf in the Trials…

906.name: Bud Elf
906.dialog: Yeah yeah I've heard all the stories.

907.name: Bud Elf
907.dialog: Like the one about how you managed to run slower than other people who aren't even running the one about it taking 5 minutes to complete a 400-meter course

908.name: Bud Elf
908.dialog: the one about how nodding is your way of doing sit-ups and the one about how you trip over yourself on flat ground.

909.name: Bud Elf
909.dialog: I know all about those. Don't worry too much it's just a Trial. I've got this.

910.name: Holly
910.dialog: … Can we please not talk about these embarrassing stories of mine?

911.name: Holly
911.dialog: … On second thought no let's talk about them.

912.name: Holly
912.dialog: Then you should know perfectly well that I'm nothing but dead weight when it comes to anything too strenuous. I'm sorry for any trouble I may cause…

913.name: Bud Elf
913.dialog: I insisted didn't I? I will take responsibility if anything bad happens. You don't have to beat yourself up too much on this.

914.name: Bud Elf
914.dialog: Besides there must be something that you're good at.

915.name: Holly
915.dialog: Uh… Um… Yes but I don't think they will help…

916.name: Bud Elf
916.dialog: Fine change of tactics. List three things you're good at from the top of your head.

918.name: Holly
918.dialog: Erm one I'm a plant so I can communicate with other plants ask them for help and know how to take care of them.

920.name: Holly
920.dialog: But… the "plants" in the Realm of Trials are illusions and they don't resPond to my words at all…

921.name: Holly
921.dialog: In a real forest I can ask the forest to bless us but here…

922.name: Bud Elf
922.dialog: One down two to go. What else?

923.name: Holly
923.dialog: I… I can play the flute and sing. Senpai and other classmates said that my music is beautiful.

925.name: Bud Elf
925.dialog: Go on there's still one left!

927.name: Holly
927.dialog: And… Uh… I know basic first aid…

928.name: Holly
928.dialog: … But Dr. Raphael and Vera are way better at this than me…

929.name: Bud Elf
929.dialog: Well those don't sound useless to me.

931.name: Bud Elf
931.dialog: You're a plant and I like plants.

932.name: Bud Elf
932.dialog: You know how to take care of plants so we have a lot in common and you don't annoy me as the others do.

933.name: Bud Elf
933.dialog: I feel at ease in the presence of someone else who shares my interests.

934.name: Bud Elf
934.dialog: And look at the trial grounds: there are nothing but enemies here.

935.name: Bud Elf
935.dialog: You can play the flute and sing so I won't get bored to death.

936.name: Holly
936.dialog: If you would like to hear me play then I'd be glad to oblige…

937.name: Holly
937.dialog: Does it really count as helping when all I do is keep you company?

938.name: Bud Elf
938.dialog: At least you alleviate my bad mood which is more help than I can say for some people.

939.name: Bud Elf
939.dialog: Such as Aquaris who serves only to annoy me. I'd probably end up beating her than the enemies in the Trials if we're in the same team.

940.name: Holly
940.dialog: Um should we be talking about Aquaris behind her back like this…?

942.name: Bud Elf
942.dialog: What's more you know first aid! I can confidently say that I know nothing about this. If I'm injured then I have to wait until I clear this Trial before I can get my wounds looked at if you're not here.

943.name: Bud Elf
943.dialog: You're being very helpful in my books. I'll handle the fighting and you can handle everything else. Sounds good to you?

944.name: Holly
944.dialog: … Yes! Yes I'll try my best!

945.name: Holly
945.dialog: Of course I'll be glad if you don't get injured in the first place…

947.name: Bud Elf
947.dialog: Relax Holly. As I said I'll handle the fighting.

948.name: Holly
948.dialog: But… If you are injured I need to know where the injuries are at…

949.name: Holly
949.dialog: I have to memorize their location so I can take care of them after the battle…

950.name: Bud Elf
950.dialog: I think I'll know where my wounds are. You know since they hurt?

951.name: Bud Elf
951.dialog: The enemies are getting close. Hide somewhere safe okay?

952.name: Holly
952.dialog: Okay. You won't have to worry about me!

953.dialog: Bud Elf waved her flower menacingly and rushed towards the first wave of enemies.

955.name: Holly
955.dialog: Wow Bud Elf is so strong~

956.name: Bud Elf
956.dialog: Who's talking? It sounds like… Holly?

957.name: Bud Elf
957.dialog: At least she doesn't seem to be in any danger. Better get rid of these enemies first.

958.name: Holly
958.dialog: That flower is huge but Bud Elf makes it look effortless…

961.name: Bud Elf
961.dialog: … Why do I have a bad feeling about this?

962.name: Holly
962.dialog:
♪Amidst the tune of the forest I sing♪
♪The song of a legend second to none♪

964.name: Bud Elf
964.dialog: Uh is she singing? About me?

965.name: Holly
965.dialog:
♪Against darkness she stands♪
♪From perils she finds chance♪

967.name: Holly
967.dialog:
♪The wicked cower in fear♪
♪As the pure blossom comes near♪

970.name: Bud Elf
970.dialog: That's it! No more singing for you!

971.name: Holly
971.dialog: Hmmmph… Why?? I thought you liked my singing voice. All I wanted to do was to cheer you on…

972.name: Bud Elf
972.dialog: Try a normal song next time! I mean what were you even singing back there? None of that is true!

973.name: Bud Elf
973.dialog: … You shouldn't even be singing about me in the first place!

974.name: Holly
974.dialog: What are you talking about? It's totally true! Sure I might have embellished it a bit but you're just that amazing!

975.name: Holly
975.dialog: Besides I'm the only one here to witness your awe-inspiring battles! I'm going to sing them to everyone once we return to the Academy.

976.name: Holly
976.dialog: And they will finally realize that they're missing out!

977.name: Bud Elf
977.dialog: Somehow I feel like this will backfire terribly…

978.name: Bud Elf
978.dialog: And please don't do that. Please.

979.name: Holly
979.dialog: Oh no there's a wound on your hand! Please sit down I'll take care of it now.

980.name: Bud Elf
980.dialog: You don't have to worry too much Holly it's just a small cut.

981.name: Holly
981.dialog: Are you injured anywhere else? I have the gauze and disinfectant ready.

982.name: Bud Elf
982.dialog: Nah that's the only one and it's a small wound.

983.name: Holly
983.dialog: (Blows on the wound) Pain pain go away…

986.name: Bud Elf
986.dialog: Erm was it really necessary to wrap my entire hand?

987.name: Holly
987.dialog: Absolutely! All wounds have to be treated carefully!

988.title: Some Things Never Change
988.name: Holly
988.dialog: So this is what happened in the Realm of Trials last time…

989.name: Susan
989.dialog: Hahaha that's right! Effie is just that awesome!

990.name: Susan
990.dialog: You're also something yourself. Not everyone has what it takes to be Effie's friend.

991.name: Holly
991.dialog: I still can't believe I really became friends with the legendary Bud Elf…

992.name: Bud Elf
992.dialog: I don't mind the two of you chatting but can you maybe move your conversation elsewhere? It's sort of uncomfortable when you're squished between two people…

993.name: Susan
993.dialog: Why should we? This is our way to show our affections~

994.dialog: Huh now that's not something you see every day.

995.name: Iron Fist
995.dialog: It's Holly and Bud Elf! They look like they're getting along really well.

996.name: Mio
996.dialog: Meow! Are you sure that Holly is not forced to be Bud Elf's friend?

997.name: Aquaris
997.dialog: Doesn't look like it. Look at that huge grin on Holly's face!

998.name: Aquaris
998.dialog: Is Bud Elf more amiable now? If that's the case I should go say hi!

1002.name: Aquaris
1002.dialog: Bud Elf! How did you get Holly to team up with you?

1003.name: Aquaris
1003.dialog: … Did I say something wrong? Why are you glaring at me?

1004.name: Holly
1004.dialog: Uh Aquaris you might want to look down.

1005.dialog: Everyone looked at Aquaris who shakily looked down.

1007.name: Susan
1007.dialog: What a naughty flower! What is it doing outside of the flower bed?

1008.name: Iron Fist
1008.dialog: (Whispers) Aquaris this is your cue to run.

1011.name: Bud Elf
1011.dialog: You again! Trampling all over my beloved plant friends! I will hammer the lesson into your brick head this time!!

1013.name: Susan
1013.dialog: Haha Elffie runs as fast as I remembered~

1014.name: Holly
1014.dialog: Are you sure everything is alright?

1015.name: Susan
1015.dialog: Of course! Aquaris is no match for Elffie so there's nothing to worry about!

1016.dialog: I think it's Aquaris we need to worry about not Bud Elf.

1017.name: Iron Fist
1017.dialog: It seems like nothing changed with Bud Elf after all.

1018.name: Mio
1018.dialog: Meow… So is Bud Elf kinder to Holly because she is a plant?

1019.name: Holly
1019.dialog: Of course not! Bud Elf is always kind!

1021.name: Holly
1021.dialog: That's because she stepped on the flower. As long as no plants are hurt…

1022.name: Susan
1022.dialog: I think Aquaris is secretly a genius at grating on Elffie's nerves. She never fails to make Elffie angry!

1023.name: Holly
1023.dialog: That's right! So it's not Bud Elf's fault that she's always angry with Aquaris!

1024.dialog: By the way I saw you and Bud Elf registered as a team in the Realm of Trials. Is that how you got to know each other?

1026.dialog: How was it? Did you manage to get a lot of Origami Cranes?

1027.name: Holly
1027.dialog: We did… Bud Elf was amazing…

1028.name: Holly
1028.dialog: The treasure we got from the Pond of Prayers was extremely valuable as well… at least that's what President KongMing said.

1029.name: Iron Fist
1029.dialog: Sounds like House Monster has to work harder to win this contest!

1030.name: Holly
1030.dialog: I wrote a song praising Bud Elf back in the Realm of Trials…

1031.name: Holly
1031.dialog: I'd like to share it with you…

1033.name: Aquaris
1033.dialog: Huff huff huff… I can't run anymore please forgive me… Wait is someone singing?

1034.name: Bud Elf
1034.dialog: Holly!! I told you not to sing it anymore!!!

1035.title: Sivney's Research
1035.name: Sivney
1035.dialog: Have you finished organizing the data?

1038.name: Sivney
1038.dialog: Now if we put this together with the data that we finished organizing earlier…

1040.name: Sivney
1040.dialog: It appears that items granted by the Pond of Prayers may have a connection with the wish made by the person offering the Origami Cranes…

1041.name: Sivney
1041.dialog: The more focused the person making the wish is the more prone the Pond of Prayers will be to fulfill their wish exactly according to their thoughts.

1042.name: Sivney
1042.dialog: Hmm… I see. This is how "the Gods respond to prayers made by the pure-hearted"…

1043.name: Sivney
1043.dialog: The Pond has a processor with psychic powers but it lacks the ability to filter out distractors.

1044.name: Sivney
1044.dialog: Report 121 states that the subject wished for herbs and swords but received a fanny pack instead.

1045.name: Sivney
1045.dialog: My theory is that it identifies the category the wish is associated with based on past patterns and keywords. Irrelevant thoughts only serve to disrupt the processor from arriving at the desired result.

1046.name: Sivney
1046.dialog: Hmm and if I factor in the influences of pronunciation and language structure of the ancient Tsuruga dialect…

1048.name: Sivney
1048.dialog: Haha I wouldn't be surprised if you manage to do better than that.

1049.name: Sivney
1049.dialog: It IS ancient in terms of technology after all.

1050.name: Sivney
1050.dialog: But we're not here to optimize it are we? Our job is to figure out how it works so the Academy can utilize it better.

1052.name: Sivney
1052.dialog: Of course I did consider taking it apart and studying its structure.

1053.name: Sivney
1053.dialog: I probably would have but as you can see…

1055.name: Sivney
1055.dialog: It might not be the best course of action when we have a guard watching us like a hawk.

1056.name: Sivney
1056.dialog: Now that I think about it she seems to be oddly cautious of me despite the fact that we've never met before.

1057.name: Sivney
1057.dialog: Perhaps a certain Senpai told her about me? Hmm…

1058.name: Sivney
1058.dialog: Ah I'm getting off course. Back to our research… From what we've gleaned by analyzing these data we can conclude that we should have the more simple-minded students make wishes.

1060.name: Sivney
1060.dialog: Yes certainly you can have a try at this later too.

1061.name: Sivney
1061.dialog: Moving on to our next topic: the correlation between the number of Origami Cranes offered and the result of wishes.

1062.name: Sivney
1062.dialog: So far we can observe that the results agree with our expectations: the more Origami Cranes offered the more valuable the prize will be.

1063.name: Sivney
1063.dialog: If the wisher offers one Origami Crane only for a life-saving elixir the Pond will grant a licorice leaf. However if the number of Origami Cranes offered is increased then rarer herbs or even medicine pills may be granted.

1064.name: Sivney
1064.dialog: It should also be noted that the items from the Pond are up-to-date with the time period the wish was made despite them being far after the time the Pond was created.

1065.name: Sivney
1065.dialog: (Mumbles) How unfortunate. I would have loved to study the inner workings of the Pond of Prayers…

1067.name: Sivney
1067.dialog: Ahem. There have also been reports of the wisher offering more Origami Cranes but receiving a less desired result.

1068.name: Sivney
1068.dialog: What the Pond deems to be valuable seems to differ from the general crowd.

1069.name: Sivney
1069.dialog: Our next goal is to figure out the relationship between different types of wishes the number of Origami Cranes offered and the quality of the rewards.

1070.name: Sivney
1070.dialog: Hmph the data we have now is insufficient to deduce how to achieve the best results with the least cost.

1071.name: Sivney
1071.dialog: Come on Bonnie it's time for us to get our hands on some Origami Cranes for the sake of our research.

1073.name: Sivney
1073.dialog: Going in teams? That rule is set to ensure the safety of students who dare to take on the trials but I'm not a regular student am I?

1074.name: Sivney
1074.dialog: Besides that's why I have you Bonnie. Let's go!

1076.dialog: As Bonnie skips towards the entrance of the Realm of Trials an invisible force rams into her and knocks her to the ground.

1079.name: Sivney
1079.dialog: Hm I smell blood… The person or beast that knocked you over must be invisible.

1080.name: Sivney
1080.dialog: Wait the space on top of Bonnie is being distorted… It's the effects of Optical Camouflage!

1081.name: Sivney
1081.dialog: Hello? Can you get up? You're crushing my Bonnie here.

1085.title: The Invisible Girl
1085.name: Sivney
1085.dialog: Try moving your left wing Bonnie.

1087.name: Sivney
1087.dialog: Does it hurt if I squeeze it lightly like this?

1089.name: Sivney
1089.dialog: Great! Looks like the bone isn't broken.

1090.name: Sivney
1090.dialog: Phew just when I was worried that I have to find myself a new research assistant…

1092.name: Sivney
1092.dialog: I'm joking Bonnie no one is good enough to replace you. You're the best assistant I ever had.

1093.name: Sivney
1093.dialog: Well well well let's see which bumbling fool almost murdered my best assistant…

1094.name: Trinity
1094.dialog: Mana depleting… Entering Sleep Mode… Zzzz…

1097.name: Trinity
1097.dialog: Wait that's not right. I should be out of the Realm of Trials by now.

1099.name: Sivney
1099.dialog: I'm sorry do I know you?

1101.name: Trinity
1101.dialog: Don't you remember me Dr. Sivney?!

1104.name: Sivney
1104.dialog: Aww of course I remember you. I was just pulling your leg.

1105.name: Sivney
1105.dialog: I can still recall making that Battle Suit…

1109.name: Sivney
1109.dialog: Ha look at that expression on your face! It's Trinity right?

1111.name: Sivney
1111.dialog: (Not until the Battle Suit jogged my memory.)

1112.name: Sivney
1112.dialog: Since you've just returned from the Trials I'd like a detailed report on the situation inside the Realm of Trials.

1113.name: Sivney
1113.dialog: I can also use another person to help me gather data for my research on the Pond of Prayers. I'll tell you what to wish for later.

1116.name: Sivney
1116.dialog: What's the matter? Don't tell me that you've forgotten how to deliver a proper report despite having studied under me…

1117.name: Trinity
1117.dialog: N-No I will never forget what you taught me!

1119.dialog: Trinity reluctantly recounted her experience in the Trials.

1120.name: Sivney
1120.dialog: So let me get this straight: you stopped at the third stage due to a bout of drowsiness.

1121.name: Trinity
1121.dialog: I couldn't keep my eyes open. I managed to clear the stage I was in but it would have been risky to venture into the next stage.

1122.name: Trinity
1122.dialog: I didn't want you to know because it was so embarrassing…

1123.name: Sivney
1123.dialog: What happened to your teammates? This shouldn't have been a problem if they were there to watch your back and wake you if you fall asleep.

1124.name: Trinity
1124.dialog: None exist. They're always looking at me like I'm a freak! There's no way I'm teaming up with them!

1125.name: Trinity
1125.dialog: It's not a crime if you don't get caught so I wouldn't be breaking school rules if no one caught me in the act.

1126.name: Trinity
1126.dialog: Hence the Optical Camouflage… Oops. Dr. Sivney you won't tell on me right?

1127.name: Sivney
1127.dialog: I have better things to do than being a tattle-tale… There everything's recorded now. If there's nothing more to add I'll be taking my leave.

1128.name: Trinity
1128.dialog: Uh Dr. Sivney what about the rules?

1130.name: Sivney
1130.dialog: Well I'm not heading in there myself am I? I'm teamed up with Bonnie who is perfectly capable of pulling her weight.

1132.name: Trinity
1132.dialog: … Can can I go with you?

1133.name: Sivney
1133.dialog: I have nothing against that but shouldn't you get your wounds treated first?

1134.name: Trinity
1134.dialog: Nah they're minor ones that don't hinder my performance. Don't worry!

1139.name: Sivney
1139.dialog: Said by someone who landed on their face.

1142.name: Trinity
1142.dialog: (Hisses in pain) Ugh I think I reopened a wound…

1143.name: Sivney
1143.dialog: Are you alright? You can rest on the sidelines if you need to.

1144.name: Trinity
1144.dialog: (And waste my chance to impress Dr. Sivney? Never!)

1148.name: Sivney
1148.dialog: There's smoke coming from your rifle Trinity.

1149.name: Trinity
1149.dialog: Soul Destruction took a hit from the monsters just now… Is it malfunctioning?

1151.name: Trinity
1151.dialog: The Energy Storage Cell is sending a warning message… Yikes it's burning hot!

1153.name: Trinity
1153.dialog: Please give me some more time I'll have it up and running again in no time!

1158.name: Trinity
1158.dialog: This is fixed… This is also fixed… These parts need replacing…

1159.name: Sivney
1159.dialog: Hmm you're pretty skilled at this. Have you been practising in your spare time?

1160.name: Trinity
1160.dialog: Yep! I've read through the notes you gifted me many times and tried to make adjustments on the Battle Suit and Soul Destruction myself!

1161.name: Sivney
1161.dialog: (Notes? But those have to be at least half a century old…)

1163.name: Trinity
1163.dialog: On the topic of Battle Suits there's something I've always wanted to ask…

1165.name: Trinity
1165.dialog: There's nothing strange with the Battle Suit's design right?

1166.name: Trinity
1166.dialog: I remember you telling me that this is normal in the outside world.

1168.name: Trinity
1168.dialog: Phew… I told them that this style is common in outfits!

1171.name: Sivney
1171.dialog: I don't remember the Battle Suit being this tight-fitting when I designed it…

1172.name: Sivney
1172.dialog: Its material shouldn't shrink with wash…

1175.name: Trinity
1175.dialog: If the Battle Suit hasn't shrunk…

1176.name: Trinity
1176.dialog: This means that… I've gained weight…

1177.name: Trinity
1177.dialog: I should probably... Go on a diet…

1179.name: Sivney
1179.dialog: Oookay I might have went a bit overboard.

1180.name: Sivney
1180.dialog: I was just teasing you Trinity.

1182.name: Sivney
1182.dialog: The style of the Battle Suit is normal by my standards but might be a bit too advanced for the general crowd.

1183.name: Sivney
1183.dialog: Brilliant thoughts are often misunderstood by others…

1184.name: Sivney
1184.dialog: … But you're not the general crowd are you Trinity?

1185.name: Trinity
1185.dialog: Of course! Everyone can only dream of seeing the world as you do Dr. Sivney!

1186.title: Trying Too Hard
1186.name: Trinity
1186.dialog: …There! Soul Destruction is fully operational again!

1187.name: Trinity
1187.dialog: With it I shall bring you victory!

1188.name: Sivney
1188.dialog: The sentiment is appreciated but isn't Soul Destruction a sniper rifle? Those aren't made for engaging in close-ranged combat. You should stay in the back and cover me.

1189.name: Trinity
1189.dialog: But… my chance to impress Dr. Sivney…

1190.name: Trinity
1190.dialog: Ahem I mean I've cleared the first three stages by myself several times before! I know what I'm doing!

1193.name: Sivney
1193.dialog: …Then it shouldn't be too hard for you to aim at different body parts of the monsters so I can observe what their weaknesses are right?

1195.name: Trinity
1195.dialog: (Gulps) That is a lot harder than taking them out but I'll try my best!

1199.name: Trinity
1199.dialog: No signs of tiring yet. Is this because I am with Dr. Sivney now…?

1200.name: Trinity
1200.dialog: Awesome Dr. Sivney will surely be impressed by how much I've grown!

1203.name: Trinity
1203.dialog: You're right where I want you to be! Take this!

1207.name: Trinity
1207.dialog: What is that noise…? Is it a trick of my mind or is it…

1209.name: Trinity
1209.dialog: Oh you're trying to attack all at once now?

1210.name: Trinity
1210.dialog: Nice plan but you are no match for me when I'm fully awake!

1218.name: Sivney
1218.dialog: I have no sympathy for brutes like you who try to hurt a sleeping girl in her most vulnerable state…

1226.name: Sivney
1226.dialog: Hm her Battle Suit and Soul Destruction is still misfunctioning and draining all mana from her.

1227.name: Sivney
1227.dialog: With no other method to replenish mana sleep may be the best option here.

1231.name: Sivney
1231.dialog: I should probably fix her Battle Suit or it will keep draining her mana.

1232.name: Sivney
1232.dialog: …But where’s the fun in working on something that I'm already finished with?

1233.name: Sivney
1233.dialog: Hmm… Can you do it Bonnie?

1237.name: Sivney
1237.dialog: Seriously? You're saying that you can't fix this because some strange adjustments have been made?

1238.name: Sivney
1238.dialog: I thought you were better than that Bonnie!

1240.name: Sivney
1240.dialog: (Sighs) I suppose I have no choice…

1241.dialog: Sivney starts to work on Trinity's Gear.

1242.name: Sivney
1242.dialog: Yikes what happened to my perfectly designed Suit and Weapon?

1243.name: Sivney
1243.dialog: Every module clashes with each other and the parts don't fit at all. It's a miracle that they're still functional!

1244.name: Sivney
1244.dialog: Gear that runs despite the errors…

1245.name: Sivney
1245.dialog: There's no way someone without my level of genius can make heads or tails of this mess.

1246.name: Sivney
1246.dialog: Hm? This is the power output module…

1250.name: Trinity
1250.dialog: Dr. Sivney! Oh no did I fall asleep again?

1251.name: Trinity
1251.dialog: I've made a fool of myself…

1252.name: Trinity
1252.dialog: You must be very disappointed in me…

1254.name: Sivney
1254.dialog: Did you adjust your equipment yourself?

1255.name: Trinity
1255.dialog: Yes… I did what I could based on the notes you left me but my skills are mediocre at best…

1256.name: Sivney
1256.dialog: Despite the time you spent studying under me and the aid my notes gave you you still managed to butcher my perfect invention.

1257.name: Sivney
1257.dialog: If you're looking for praise you're certainly barking up the wrong tree.

1259.name: Sivney
1259.dialog: My design's energy conversion efficiency was at least at 80% and now it barely reaches 30%. That's why you're constantly drowzy.

1260.name: Sivney
1260.dialog: What were you thinking when you tinkered with the power output module?

1261.name: Trinity
1261.dialog: Be-because… My foes were becoming stronger than ever and I needed more firepower...

1262.name: Trinity
1262.dialog: I wanted to be of help to the Academy and had an idea on how to improve my gear…

1263.name: Trinity
1263.dialog: After replacing the heat conductor and increasing the beam energy concentration of the rifle the performance of the rifle in terms of both range and potency were significantly improved.

1265.name: Trinity
1265.dialog: I shouldn't have meddled with your design… I'm so sorry…

1269.name: Sivney
1269.dialog: You did make a mess of the whole contraption but I am quite satisfied with the changes you made to the power output module.

1270.name: Sivney
1270.dialog: That bout of genius proves that your time spent with me hasn't gone to waste.

1273.name: Sivney
1273.dialog: Nah that was me having fun messing with you.

1275.name: Sivney
1275.dialog: You do seem to be gifted in this field. If you would like to further your studies you can borrow my research notes.

1276.name: Sivney
1276.dialog: If I have time to spare I might also answer some questions of yours.

9999993.name: Teresa
9999993.dialog: That "Trial" of the Tsuruga Grand Shrine sounds fun… What I wouldn't give for a good fight now!

1279.name: Teresa
1279.dialog: Hmm? What is Mika doing over there crouched on the ground like that?

1282.name: Teresa
1282.dialog: What are you doing on the ground? Your hands are covered in mud.

1283.dialog: Teresa paused briefly as realization struck her.

1284.name: Teresa
1284.dialog: Don't tell me that you're still hung up on what happened in the past.

1285.name: Teresa
1285.dialog: It's been years since that happened! Fixating on your past failures is not healthy for you.

1288.name: Mika
1288.dialog: The past is set in stone; thinking about it won't change anything.

1289.name: Teresa
1289.dialog: What are you doing then if not dwelling on the past?

1290.dialog: Mika looked at the clay doll held in her hands. She had just finished molding its shape.

1292.dialog: She paused again as if searching for the correct words.

1293.name: Mika
1293.dialog: I am just… passing the time.

1294.name: Teresa
1294.dialog: Hmph… Sure if you say so.

1295.name: Teresa
1295.dialog: Though if I had to choose a way to pass the time I'd choose drinking. Beats getting your hands all dirty.

1296.name: Teresa
1296.dialog: You're not fooling anyone here Mika.

1297.dialog: Mika smiled not denying nor confirming Teresa's accusations.

1299.dialog: Mika stood up and brushed dust away from her clothes still holding the clay doll.

1300.name: Mika
1300.dialog: Despite your status as a nun you are free and unburdened going where you please whenever you please.

1301.name: Mika
1301.dialog: It must be nice to have the freedom to just… be yourself.

1302.name: Teresa
1302.dialog: Um who else should I be if not myself?

1303.name: Teresa
1303.dialog: Besides the Church of Violence isn't that strict.

1304.dialog: Teresa munched on a Spicy Fishie as another thought struck her.

1305.name: Teresa
1305.dialog: Do you want to try challenging a Trial with me?

1307.name: Teresa
1307.dialog: Yeah the ones in the Tsuruga Grand Shrine. It's one of the most popular activities for Yume Academy students now.

1308.name: Mika
1308.dialog: I have heard of it; Senpai mentioned it to me the other day. However my abilities lean towards the defensive instead of the offensive.

1309.name: Mika
1309.dialog: I fear that I wouldn't be of much use in these Trials where one has to clear one challenge after another for the prize.

1311.name: Teresa
1311.dialog: Physically you've stopped working on that doll of yours but mentally you're still stuck aren't you?

1312.name: Teresa
1312.dialog: You need to get up and start moving. Having too much free time on your hands will only pull you into the depths of self-scrutiny and you'll never find your way out!

1313.name: Mika
1313.dialog: Now that marks the first time I've heard you say anything that remotely represents what a nun might say.

1316.name: Teresa
1316.dialog: Trust me I know what I'm doing.

1317.name: Teresa
1317.dialog: You can't stop moving forward. Life is like going upstream; you can either allow yourself to be washed away by the pains of the past or brave them and move on.

1318.name: Teresa
1318.dialog: The best way of stopping your past from getting to you is by overwriting them with new experiences and new memories.

1319.name: Teresa
1319.dialog: That's the secret of my free unburdened life.

1320.name: Teresa
1320.dialog: Don't go telling everyone else okay?

1323.name: Teresa
1323.dialog: (Coughs) The air here is foul just like that young Shrine Maiden said.

1324.dialog: Teresa waved her hands around a futile attempt at dispersing the nauseating smoke that permeated the air.

1325.name: Mika
1325.dialog: I heard that a large portion of visitors to the Shrine aren't here for religious purposes.

1326.name: Mika
1326.dialog: Most have their eyes on the Trial rewards only.

1330.name: Teresa
1330.dialog: Nah I don't charge for that. I was just surprised that the Shrine Maidens actually tolerated these people in their Shrine.

1333.name: Teresa
1333.dialog: … (Sighs) It's none of my business anyway.

1335.name: Teresa
1335.dialog: Realm of Trials here I come!

1336.name: Mika
1336.dialog: The enemies here sure look unusual.

1337.name: Teresa
1337.dialog: What do they call them again… Monsters? Shrine Monsters?

1338.name: Mika
1338.dialog: They were supposed to be spawned from negative emotions.

1340.name: Teresa
1340.dialog: They do look the part with darkness oozing from every pore.

1341.name: Mika
1341.dialog: If they are truly born from negative emotions then wouldn't it be better to appease and purify them? We would be doing them a favor for them this way.

1343.name: Teresa
1343.dialog: The only reason I'm taking on the Trials is for a good fight; I wouldn't be here otherwise.

1344.name: Teresa
1344.dialog: There's no need to waste our efforts on "comforting" them when we can just vanquish them!

1345.dialog: Teresa brandished her weapon with gusto.

1346.name: Teresa
1346.dialog: Why ruin the fun? I've been looking forward to unleashing carnage on these abominations!

1347.dialog: The Nun's eyes gleamed with a wild primal light as she spoke excitedly.

1348.name: Mika
1348.dialog: (A true nun of the Church of Violence turning to violence no matter the circumstances.)

1350.dialog: A Shrine Monster snuck up on Mika when she was lost in thought and was about to strike her down. Luckily Teresa blocked the blow before it landed.

1351.name: Teresa
1351.dialog: Oi keep your head in the game. I brought you here so you can get out of your head not for you to get stuck deeper in it.

1355.name: Teresa
1355.dialog: You can choose to live in the present and live every moment to the fullest… Or to live in the past and be devoured by your past demons.

1356.dialog: Teresa said forcefully as she slashed and hacked at the waves of Monsters rushing at them.

1358.name: Teresa
1358.dialog: Personally I would prefer the former instead of the latter!

1359.dialog: Every hit of Teresa's struck true and the Monster wailed before shattering into pieces.

1360.dialog: The remains of the Monsters were dark as ink and left black stains on the walls and floorboards of the Shrine.

1361.name: Mika
1361.dialog: (Is this why you believe in violence so much…?)

1364.dialog: Teresa grinned widely and patted Mika's shoulder.

1365.name: Mika
1365.dialog: If it wasn't for you that last wave of Monsters would have…

1367.name: Teresa
1367.dialog: We deserve a break after all that fighting. I would kill for a nice keg of beer now…

1368.dialog: Teresa sat cross-legged on the floor looking comfortable.

1370.name: Teresa
1370.dialog: What's on your mind? You look troubled again.

1371.dialog: Mika stood tensely in front of Teresa worried about what she was about to say.

1372.name: Mika
1372.dialog: But… Swinging your sword around and exhausting yourself with excitement... Isn't that the same as avoiding the problem?

1374.name: Mika
1374.dialog: Can one truly move on from their past demons while living like this?

1375.name: Mika
1375.dialog: If we do not address the problems if excitement is all we live for…

1376.dialog: The former Swordmaster gazed intently at her teammate frowning.

1377.name: Mika
1377.dialog: … Aren't we just averting our eyes from them?

1378.name: Mika
1378.dialog: Our past is a part of us and no matter how far we go… It will eventually catch up with us.

1379.dialog: Teresa's eyes widened in astonishment. What Mika said contradicted what she believed for the main part of her life.

1381.dialog: This was the first time her core beliefs have been described that way.

1384.dialog: A long long time has passed since Teresa started to live her life like the protagonist of a movie.

1385.dialog: She crammed one exhilarating event after another into her life to escape from her past demons

1386.dialog: but they always catch up when she stops for a break.

1387.dialog: The only thing she could do was to lengthen the time in between breaks to the best of her abilities which exhausted her.

1390.name: Teresa
1390.dialog: Should I take a page from your book and hold onto a clay doll like a lifeline? Has it made you feel any better?

1393.name: Mika
1393.dialog: I don't know what happened to you Teresa but…

1397.dialog: Teresa pulled Mika away from the dark shadow and slashed it into pieces.

1400.name: Teresa
1400.dialog: Hah is this all the Tsuruga Grand Shrine's ominous "Trials" have to offer?

1407.name: Teresa
1407.dialog: Ugh you're making my head hurt.

1408.name: Mika
1408.dialog: Teresa? Are they saying your name?

1410.dialog: Frustrated by their wails Teresa flew into a rage and her slashes became more forceful.

1278.title: Secret to Living Freely
1278.name: Teresa
1278.dialog: That "Trial" of the Tsuruga Grand Shrine sounds fun… What I wouldn't give for a good fight now!

text.SHRINE_HURDLE_HELP:
Tsuruga Grand Shrine

Realm of Trials Time Rule|Realm of Trials will occur in seasons consisting of a challenge phase (12 days) and a rest phase (2 days).

Entry Rules|1. At the beginning of each season the number of Trial Invitations owned will be set to 15 (max capacity).|2. There will be 3 different Trials in each season with different environmental effects in each Trial to boost your Girls in different ways. You can choose which Trial to enter manually. It will cost you 1 Trial Invitation to enter a Trial.|3. Only Girls who are 10-star or above can be chosen for Trials once a Girl is chosen to enter a Trial her attribute and status in this Trial (including her Gear and Potential status) will not be updated by the adjustments you make in other features.

Difficulty Level|1. You will need to choose the Difficulty Level once you enter a Trial.|2. The enemies' attributes and points they provide after each battle will be boosted if you choose a higher Difficulty Level.|3. Higher Difficulty Levels can be unlocked as your points recorded for Trials become higher.|4 After unlocking a Difficulty Level it will remain unlocked in the following seasons.

Trial Rules|There are 15 Stages in a Trial where you will encounter Battle Stages Reward Stages Store Stages Recover Stages and Boss Stages in your Trials.|Battle Stage|1. Enemies spawn at random you can tap on the icons of the enemies to check out their status. You can choose to deploy your Girls to defeat the enemies and win points.|2. Each battle of Battle Stages lasts for 15 rounds. You can win in a battle if you defeat the enemies in 15 rounds but will lose the battle if all your Girls are defeated or the battle exceeds 15 rounds.|3. The HP of your Girls will not recover after each battle.|4. The status of the enemies will be reset after you lose a battle.|Reward Stage|1. There will be 3 random buffs available for you to choose in a Reward Stage.|2. You can also give up a chance to get a buff and receive Trial Tokens instead. Trial Tokens can be used in Store Stages.|Store Stage|1. Buff Purchase: there will be 3 random buffs available for you to purchase with Trial Tokens.|2. Buff Upgrade: 3 random buffs you own will appear you can choose to upgrade them with Trial Tokens. Each buff can be upgraded twice in a Trial.|Recover Stage|1. You can choose to heal your Girls or revive a defeated Girl in a Recover Stage.|Boss Stage|1. You can only challenge a Boss Stage once in a Trial. (There's only 1 Boss Stage in each Trial) You will complete the Trial after the battle.|2. The enemy in Boss Stage cannot be defeated you can earn more points if you deal higher damage in the stage.

Points and Ranking|1. Your overall points from all 3 Trials will be recorded and ranked. Points earned for each Trial will also be ranked. Once the challenge phase ends rewards will be sent according to rankings.

Tasks|1. Tasks will be refreshed at the start of each season.

Pond of Prayers|1. You can exchange rewards with "Origami Cranes" in Pond of Prayers.|2. Seasonal merchandise will be refreshed at the start of each season but permanent merchandise will not be refreshed.

text.SHRINE_HURDLE_AUTO_HELP: Auto-Battle Feature:|1. Once auto-battle is activated you will enter the next Stage with a Lineup you set in the setup page.|2. When selecting the Stage to enter the system will try to avoid selecting a Battle Stage. Your selection for buffs or Healing plans in Reward Stages and Recovery Stages will always be the first option. You can choose whether to enter Recovery Stages or Store Stages or not when setting the feature.|3. When you enter a Store Stage the system will try to purchase and upgrade the buffs in order until your Trial Tokens are insufficient for any purchase or upgrades. You can also set to manage the purchase and upgrades manually in Store Stages when setting the feature.|4. Auto-battle will stop when entering the Boss Stage or when you leave the Trial.|5. You can set whether to stop auto-battle when a Girl is defeated in battle. If you choose not to stop the feature in this situation the system will automatically fill your lineup with Girls available in order of their Power (from high to low) until all your Girls available are defeated.
